"Okay, then we will find another way." Selina said in a more serious tone.
The water around her turned into hundreds of thin blades.
Of course, she was not alone, several other awakened who had come from Vhalaris to help were also helping her fight the mage.
Their battle had only just begun.
On another side, the undead with the largest body attacked directly toward the center of the group’s formation.
Rindo and Cassian almost moved in front of him at the same time, the guardian’s first attack hit the shield of one of the heavy awakened who had the role of a tank.
The metal bent and the man was thrown several meters backward with his shield.
The student council president entered from the right and his sword hit the guardian’s side.
A wound appeared but the creature did not even look at him.
Cassian attacked from behind and still nothing stopped it, the Cindari’s body was being damaged but it seemed as if pain did not exist for him.

His only goal was to break the formation and for this, he seemed ready to sacrifice anything necessary, this was the formation that had formed between the five Cindari and the body of the infected Titan, where Lian was also standing.
Of course, there was still one Cindari on the other side, the same Cindari that Aren was fighting, the root controller, and they were waiting for a chance to pull him out from that side as well.
And in any case, the awakened had no plan to let them pass through again.
Rindo clenched his teeth.
"Hold the line!
It does not need to fall!
Just don’t let it pass!" Then he shouted and threw himself in front of the creature again.
And in the center of everything, Sindar moved.
Darian had kept his eyes on him from the very beginning, he raised the Seven-Colored Sky Bow, his left hand held the body of the bow and his right hand moved backward.
But there was no physical arrow in his hand.
He pulled the string, light gathered around the bow.
Red.
Orange.
Yellow.
Green.
Blue.
Indigo.
Purple.
The seven colors gathered at one point and Sindar turned his eyes toward him.
Darian released the string, a thin arrow of light was fired, for a moment even the sound seemed to fall behind.
Then—
BOOOOOOM!
Sindar raised both hands, the arrow of light hit in front of him, the force of the explosion pushed the dirt around him away for dozens of meters.
His body even moved several meters backward ...not much but it moved backward!
For a moment, almost everyone who had a chance to look turned their heads toward Darian.
Rindo even gave a short smile in the middle of the battle.
"I knew it."and then said under his breath, now he understood why he had felt danger from this boy, so the truth was that he was hiding great power.
Darian did not care, he raised his bow again and the light started gathering once more.
But this time Sindar did not wait, in one moment he disappeared from his position.
The Vorhelm could only place his bow horizontally in front of his body to at least block the incoming attack.
Cindar’s fist hit it, the sound of the impact spread across the battlefield like an explosion.
Darian was pushed dozens of meters across the ground, his feet created two long lines in the dirt, but he did not fall and a small cold smile appeared on his face.

"Well, I did not expect dealing with you to be easy either." Then he said with a sharp look and raised his bow again, while also looking at the four awakened he had brought with him and signaling them to attack.
Cindar clearly did not care and prepared for his next attack, although Tavern left his own fight at that moment to strike Sindar from the side.
But before he could reach him, one of the young Cindari soldiers moved ahead of him, it was the same soldier who had fallen to his knees when he saw Sindar.
The man’s eyes still showed confusion, maybe part of him still could not see the Founder as an enemy.
Even so, he raised his weapon.
"Founder!
Why?!" The soldier shouted with a trembling voice.
Cindar looked at him, only for a moment, then his hand moved and the soldier’s body stopped in the air.
His chest suddenly sank, blood came out of his mouth and his body fell to the ground like a broken puppet.
Tavern froze, something inside him exploded.
"He was one of your people!" He shouted with pure anger and attacked directly toward Sindar.
Cindar did not even look at him, that was worse.
Tavern brought his sword down with all his strength and the Founder caught it with one hand, the metal stopped between his dried fingers.
The Cindari commander looked into his eyes for a moment.
Nothing.
No regret.
No anger.
Not even boredom.
And right there, he understood, no, that soldier was not one of Cindar’s people, none of them were, they never were.
He had created them, but not like a father who creates a child, but like a craftsman who makes a tool.
He hated his own Founder without any doubt anymore.
[Remaining Time: 07:42]
Seraphina bent her knees slightly, a line of blood ran down from her nose.
The four lines of light were still active, the chains were still moving, but holding them became harder every second.
"Are you okay?!" Liana shouted from the middle of the battle.
"I am fine!
Just fight." Seraphina answered with a rough voice and then moved her hand.

At the same time, one of the chains moved again, this time it passed above the battlefield and the root controller was forced to raise several roots to avoid a direct hit, but he was still pushed hundreds of meters away from his position.
Finally, the path was open!
All five Cindari had officially moved away from the place where the infected Titan was sleeping.
"Seris!" Rindo shouted.
Seris had been waiting for this moment from the beginning and then ordered One to move at full speed.
One moved with all his strength, the dirt under his feet cracked and his body crossed the battlefield like a huge bullet.
The root controller immediately reacted, a spear made of roots came out of the ground, directly toward One.
But Aren slammed his foot into the ground, the dirt rose and the root changed direction at the last moment, passing only a few centimeters away from One’s side.
"Keep going!" Aren shouted.
Another arrow came toward Seris from a distance, this one was an arrow created by the Cindari mage.
The Young Pendragon frowned, she was ready to dodge, but at that moment colored light passed beside her face.
The attacking arrow split apart in the air.
Darian lowered his bow and then focused his attention on Sindar again.
One increased his speed, the Cindari swordsman noticed them passing, in one moment he disappeared from in front of Tavern.
Seris only saw the flash of the blade.
But Tavern also threw himself between them with all his speed, the swords collided and he almost fell onto one knee.
Blood flowed from his palm but he blocked the path.
"Go!" Tavern shouted angrily.
One passed beside them, another chain passed above their heads and dust covered everything.
When One finally passed out of the battle line, only one person remained in front of them.
Lian.
Beside the fourth chain.
His head slowly turned toward them, the purple light in his eyes shone through the mist and darkness of the graveyard.
One slowed down, the Young Pendragon jumped down from his back and her sword came out of its sheath.
For several seconds she only looked at him, the same face, the same body, but whatever was inside those eyes no longer had any similarity to the man she knew.
She raised her sword.
"It is time for you to pay for that slap you gave me." Seris said in a cold voice and pointed the tip of her blade directly at Lian.

chapters.title: Chapter 375: Battle With The Calamity I
paragraphs: Seris pointed her sword directly at Lian.
The distance between them was probably no more than thirty meters, but those few dozen meters felt heavier to her than the entire path they had traveled to the Giant Graveyard.
One stood behind her and its antennae moved restlessly, but this time even it did not move forward.
Lian was still there beside the fourth remaining chain.
Three chains had already been broken, and every time a wave of darkness was pulled from the Titan’s body toward him, his presence became heavier.
The purple light inside his eyes was now almost impossible to ignore.
"Lian." Seris said in a low voice and did not take her eyes off his face.
There was no answer, no movement, no change in his expression, and not even the very short pause that she had seen before when he saw One or when he tried to kill her.
She raised her sword slightly higher.

"If you’re still in there, now would be a very good time to give me a sign." She continued in a cold tone, although the pressure of her hand around the hilt showed how much she was waiting for that very sign.
Lian only looked at her, that look no longer even looked like human indifference.
It was like the look of a creature that did not see a person in front of it, but only saw a living body that was still standing in its path.
Then he moved, he only took one step and Seris could not even see his full movement.
Her instinct screamed before her mind could react and her body moved to the left with all its speed.
The fist passed beside her face and the air behind her exploded.
BOOOOM!
The ground cracked several meters away and dozens of pieces of rock were thrown into the air.
A deep crack stretched from the place of impact several meters forward.
Seris landed on one leg, her eyes widened and she realized a frightening truth.
The Calamity had become stronger, much stronger than when it had come out of the cocoon.
Three chains had been broken, three more parts of the Black Silence had entered that body and the result was standing in front of her.
"Very well, so you’re not talking." The Young Pendragon muttered and lowered her sword.
Lian moved again, this time Seris did not wait, mana rose from her body and she made a counterattack.
[Moonless Severance.]
Her sword moved only once, but the cutting line did not come from the tip of the blade, it appeared almost directly on the neck of the Black Silence.
A skill that removed distance, a skill that even stronger enemies had to take seriously.
But Lian? He only raised two fingers, the cutting line was caught between them, although it was not stopped in the normal way, its path was changed.
The compressed force of the sword split upward and exploded in the air.
Seris froze for a moment, even though she had expected it, seeing the difference in power still left her unsure how to react.
[Thousand Petal swordstorm.]
Her sword moved at an incredible speed.
One strike.
Three strikes.
Seven strikes.
Then it was no longer possible to count them.
Dozens of real sword lines appeared from different angles and filled the entire area around Lian in less than a second.
From above.
Below.
Behind.
From the side.
Blind spots.
The space around the Calamity’s body became a cage of cuts, but he did not even take a step back and his right hand moved, breaking one of the lines with his palm.
He bent his head only a few centimeters and the second line passed beside his ear, his body turned slightly and two cuts passed beside him.
Three more lines hit his chest and arm, his clothes were torn but the skin underneath only received shallow scratches.
She clenched her teeth, every damn attack she made was useless! None of them could even reach him, let alone injure him.
Why was this man so powerful? Where did this power come from?
"Why him?" Seris asked angrily and rushed forward again, her sword moved upward from below.
Lian moved aside and she turned and sent the second attack directly toward his side.
He stopped it with his forearm.
The Young Pendragon used the same force, pulled her body upward and slammed her knee directly into his face.
The young Vorhelm’s head only moved slightly backward ...that was all.
Seris landed on the ground.
"Out of everyone in this world, why did you have to take his body?" She then said in a sharper voice and sent her sword toward his throat again.
Lian grabbed her wrist, very simply, the pressure of his fingers was so strong that the bones in Seris’s wrist immediately began to hurt.
She slammed her foot into his knee but it had no effect...the difference in physical strength was so great that it did nothing.
Lian pulled her and Seris lost her balance and in the next moment—
Her body was slammed into the ground.
BOOOOM!
The air left her lungs, the stone under her back broke and for a moment she could not breathe, as if the air was stuck inside her lungs and could not come back out.
"Haaa." She took deep breaths so air could enter and leave her lungs, for a moment she saw death with her own eyes.
The Black Silence raised his foot and was about to crush her skull, this time there was no pause or hesitation in those eyes, as if there was no longer any Lian inside this body controlling it.
But Seris quickly rolled away and his foot landed on the place where her head had been, the ground sank like soft dirt and a huge crater was formed ...
If she had not pulled back in time, there would probably have been nothing left of her skull ...
She got up from the ground and blood was running from the corner of her lips.
"Wasn’t one body enough?" She said angrily and wiped the blood with the back of her hand, among all the possible vessels, the damn Calamity had chosen the body of a monster.
The answer was silence again, this silence was making her even angrier.
"Go back into that damn Titan." Seris growled and attacked again.
[King’s Breaker.]
This time her attack went directly toward his shoulder joint and all the mana of her sword was gathered at one point, if it hit, even Lian’s strong body should at least be damaged for a moment.
But the Black Silence took one step forward, broke the distance and closed his hand around Seris’s forearm.
His body turned and the girl was lifted from the ground and slammed into the rock beside her again, the stone cracked and she fell among the broken pieces.
For several seconds, the only sound she could hear was the distant battle.
Magic explosions.
The sound of huge chains colliding.
Rindo’s shouts.
The sound of Darian’s bow firing.
But to Seris, all of them were far away, the only thing in front of her was that face.
Lian’s face, and that made her even more angry than any attack, she pulled herself out from the broken rocks.
"That face isn’t yours." She said very quietly this time, but the anger in her voice was even colder than before.
The Black Silence looked at her for a moment, again there was no reaction.
This time One moved, the giant ant that had seen everything from several meters away raised its antennae.
It opened the Hive Link, the feeling was immediately sent toward Lian.
The same thing that had always existed between them.
Master.
Loyalty.
Recognition.
Return.
One took a step forward, Seris gave it a short look, something moved inside her.
Maybe.
Maybe the same thing that had caused Lian to pause before would return again.
One raised its antenna slightly.
Lian looked at it but ...there was no pause, no trembling in the purple light of his eyes and no visible change in his expression, and his hand rose.
Seris understood at that exact moment.
"One!" She shouted and threw herself forward.
Lian’s attack was coming directly toward the ant’s head, the Young Pendragon threw herself between them.
Her sword rose horizontally, the fist hit the blade and the sound of metal spread through the entire area.
The sword bent in the middle and Seris’s body was thrown backward, her back hit One’s front armor and both of them were dragged several meters across the ground and she vomited blood.
If the attack had hit the ant’s body directly, even its natural armor probably could not have protected its bones.
Seris painfully moved herself away from One’s body, her hand was trembling.
Not from fear but from something worse, from realizing that maybe there was no Lian left anymore...he had paused before, twice, he had paused twice when attacking them.
Now? Nothing.
Even One could no longer cause any reaction from him ...
She looked at Lian for several seconds, for the first time she accepted the real possibility, maybe there was no one inside that body anymore.
Maybe those previous pauses were only the last movements of something that was now completely silent.
Maybe Lian was gone.

chapters.title: Chapter 376: Battle With The Calamity II
paragraphs: Seris’s eyes slowly grew colder.
There were no tears, not even the slightest trace of sorrow could be seen on her face.
She was not the kind of person who would break down and cry.
No.
There was only one thing filling her entire body.
Pure anger.
That guy...
He had been her first friend.
Her only friend.
The only person who had ever made her feel emotions she had never even known existed within her.
And somehow, that same person had made her accept something even more unbelievable.
She had acknowledged him as her greatest rival.
Seris slowly rose to her feet.
Her body was damaged, her breathing heavy, but her grip on the broken sword in her hand never loosened.
She stared forward with eyes that had lost every trace of hesitation.
There was no sadness in them anymore.
Only anger.
And a determination that was far more frightening than tears could ever be.
"Very well."
"If you’re really gone...then I have nothing left to hold back for." Seris said with eyes that showed no hesitation anymore.
Until recently, she had never thought that she could become this angry over the death of someone, especially someone outside her family.
And a terrifying killing intent came from her body.
And she looked at her Evolution Quest, now killing this Calamity would not only be for her evolution, but also to calm her anger.
The mana in her body changed, not like her previous skills, but something deeper and more dangerous.
A panel opened in front of her vision.
[Swordheart Override]
[Safe Duration: 30 seconds]
[Warning! After the safe duration ends, if the skill remains active, permanent damage to the structure of the body and soul is possible]
Seris looked at the last line for a moment, then a very small and cold smile appeared on her face.
"Thirty seconds? That’s too much." She said in a rough tone and tightened her fingers around the hilt.
Then her entire body trembled, the mana veins inside her muscles lit up like fire, and a huge amount of power spread from the center of her body to all of her limbs.
Her heart gave one heavy beat.
Then a second beat.
The speed of her blood flow increased, her muscles hurt for a moment and then the pain almost disappeared.
Time became slow for her, the dust particles in the air could now be seen one by one.
The movement of the huge chain in the distance that had looked fast a few seconds ago, now looked almost slow.
A panel appeared at the corner of her vision.
Seris disappeared, and the only thing left where she had been standing was a small explosion of dust.
Black Silence turned her head, but the girl appeared from the left.
[Moonless Severance.]
And she struck with her sword!
Lian raised his hand to respond, but before they made contact, Seris disappeared and suddenly the second strike came from behind.
Third from above.
Fourth from below.
For the first time, Black Silence was forced to use both hands, lines of cuts appeared in the air one after another.
Seris kept changing her position.
[Thousand Petal swordstorm.]
This time there were not dozens of lines.
Hundreds.
The area around Lian was filled with compressed sword cuts in less than a second.
Black Silence broke several strikes, deflected several others, and dodged some.
But not all of them, the first cut landed on his arm, the second on his chest and the third passed beside his neck, a thin line of blood appeared.
Seris saw it, her eyes became sharper, she had finally managed to cause damage!
She moved close again.
[King’s Breaker.]
The sword struck Lian’s elbow joint directly, his arm was actually pushed back and she turned, the heel of her foot struck his side.
His body was pushed back several meters, the stone under his feet cracked.
"Finally." Seris said with a very cold smile and kept her eyes on the line of blood beside Lian’s face.

But she was not too happy, because she knew that after the 30 seconds ended and the safe period was over, for every second she used the skill after that, the internal structure of her body would start to collapse.
If her use of this skill went beyond one minute, she might become almost completely paralyzed.
It was true that the skill gave its user a huge amount of power, after all, it was a Holy Rank skill, but it could also cause even greater damage.
There was silence for a moment, then something changed, the lips of Black Silence slowly moved upward.
Seris became still, this was the first smile she had seen from him since he came out of the cocoon.
But it looked nothing like the smile of the real Lian, it was too wide, too calm, like a creature that had never had a human face had just learned how these muscles should move.
The smile looked wrong on Lian’s face and the purple light in his eyes became stronger.
And for the first time and finally...he spoke!
"You have a good body too." Black Silence said in Lian’s same voice but with a completely unfamiliar tone and kept his evil smile.
The Young Pendragon did not move for a moment, not because of the sentence but because of the voice itself...it was the same voice.
But there was nothing of Lian in the way it was being used.
The Calamity tilted his head slightly and examined Seris’s body like a tool.
"Strong, fast, and adaptable." He said calmly and his eyes moved over Seris’s legs and shoulders as if he was announcing the result of an examination.
"Get lost." Seris answered angrily and gathered her mana again, she felt like a pervert was staring at her right now.
Black Silence did not care, he raised his hands and looked at his own fingers.
At his forearm and then at Lian’s body.
"I could have used you too." The Calamity said with cold satisfaction and there was a strange excitement in his voice.
Seris attacked.
But Black Silence moved back this time, not because of fear but only to continue speaking.
"Are there many bodies like yours in your world?" His hunger was clear, even thinking about the world in front of him, a world that had such creatures and high-quality food, made him salivate.
"You know, you’re really disgusting." Seris said with disgust, the idea of a creature talking about humans as if they were prey and food was not pleasant at all.
"But among all those bodies, I doubt any of them are as good as this one...so why should I change it?" The Calamity said with the same smile and slowly opened and closed his fingers.
Seris paused for a moment and the time panel at the corner of her vision was going down.
But the next sentence made her forget even the passage of time for a moment.
"This is no longer a vessel." Black Silence said in an almost possessive tone and placed his hand on Lian’s chest.
"This body is mine." The satisfaction in his voice was more frightening than any threat.
Something cold went down inside Seris, she wanted to explode from anger, she had never wanted to kill something this badly!
Every word that came out of that mouth made her want even more to tear apart this damn creature, this bastard whose hobby was destroying worlds, with her own hands!
"I finally found a body that does not limit my hunger." The Calamity continued with a smile and the purple light in his eyes became stronger.
"A body that can grow."
"A body that can learn to devour."
The Young Pendragon got stuck on that same word for a moment.
Devour.
Something about that sentence was not normal, it was as if the Calamity was not only talking about his own power, as if he had found something inside Lian’s body that had even excited him.
Seris no longer wasted time and attacked again, but now her anger was even stronger.
"I said that body is not yours!" She attacked with an angry shout and sent her sword from the right.
Black Silence blocked the strike with his forearm, a deep cut appeared, blood came out but his smile did not disappear.
"It is now." He finally said simply

sentences.text: Seris’s eyes slowly grew colder.
There were no tears, not even the slightest trace of sorrow could be seen on her face.
She was not the kind of person who would break down and cry.
No.
There was only one thing filling her entire body.
Pure anger.
That guy...
He had been her first friend.
Her only friend.
The only person who had ever made her feel emotions she had never even known existed within her.
And somehow, that same person had made her accept something even more unbelievable.
She had acknowledged him as her greatest rival.
Seris slowly rose to her feet.
Her body was damaged, her breathing heavy, but her grip on the broken sword in her hand never loosened.
She stared forward with eyes that had lost every trace of hesitation.
There was no sadness in them anymore.
Only anger.
And a determination that was far more frightening than tears could ever be.
"Very well."
"If you’re really gone...then I have nothing left to hold back for." Seris said with eyes that showed no hesitation anymore.
Until recently, she had never thought that she could become this angry over the death of someone, especially someone outside her family.
And a terrifying killing intent came from her body.
And she looked at her Evolution Quest, now killing this Calamity would not only be for her evolution, but also to calm her anger.
The mana in her body changed, not like her previous skills, but something deeper and more dangerous.
A panel opened in front of her vision.
[Swordheart Override]
[Safe Duration: 30 seconds]
[Warning!
After the safe duration ends, if the skill remains active, permanent damage to the structure of the body and soul is possible]
Seris looked at the last line for a moment, then a very small and cold smile appeared on her face.
"Thirty seconds?
That’s too much." She said in a rough tone and tightened her fingers around the hilt.
Then her entire body trembled, the mana veins inside her muscles lit up like fire, and a huge amount of power spread from the center of her body to all of her limbs.
Her heart gave one heavy beat.
Then a second beat.
The speed of her blood flow increased, her muscles hurt for a moment and then the pain almost disappeared.
Time became slow for her, the dust particles in the air could now be seen one by one.
The movement of the huge chain in the distance that had looked fast a few seconds ago, now looked almost slow.
A panel appeared at the corner of her vision.
Seris disappeared, and the only thing left where she had been standing was a small explosion of dust.
Black Silence turned her head, but the girl appeared from the left.
[Moonless Severance.]
And she struck with her sword!
Lian raised his hand to respond, but before they made contact, Seris disappeared and suddenly the second strike came from behind.
Third from above.
Fourth from below.
For the first time, Black Silence was forced to use both hands, lines of cuts appeared in the air one after another.
Seris kept changing her position.
[Thousand Petal swordstorm.]
This time there were not dozens of lines.
Hundreds.
The area around Lian was filled with compressed sword cuts in less than a second.
Black Silence broke several strikes, deflected several others, and dodged some.
But not all of them, the first cut landed on his arm, the second on his chest and the third passed beside his neck, a thin line of blood appeared.
Seris saw it, her eyes became sharper, she had finally managed to cause damage!
She moved close again.
[King’s Breaker.]
The sword struck Lian’s elbow joint directly, his arm was actually pushed back and she turned, the heel of her foot struck his side.
His body was pushed back several meters, the stone under his feet cracked.
"Finally." Seris said with a very cold smile and kept her eyes on the line of blood beside Lian’s face.

But she was not too happy, because she knew that after the 30 seconds ended and the safe period was over, for every second she used the skill after that, the internal structure of her body would start to collapse.
If her use of this skill went beyond one minute, she might become almost completely paralyzed.
It was true that the skill gave its user a huge amount of power, after all, it was a Holy Rank skill, but it could also cause even greater damage.
There was silence for a moment, then something changed, the lips of Black Silence slowly moved upward.
Seris became still, this was the first smile she had seen from him since he came out of the cocoon.
But it looked nothing like the smile of the real Lian, it was too wide, too calm, like a creature that had never had a human face had just learned how these muscles should move.
The smile looked wrong on Lian’s face and the purple light in his eyes became stronger.
And for the first time and finally...he spoke!
"You have a good body too." Black Silence said in Lian’s same voice but with a completely unfamiliar tone and kept his evil smile.
The Young Pendragon did not move for a moment, not because of the sentence but because of the voice itself...it was the same voice.
But there was nothing of Lian in the way it was being used.
The Calamity tilted his head slightly and examined Seris’s body like a tool.
"Strong, fast, and adaptable." He said calmly and his eyes moved over Seris’s legs and shoulders as if he was announcing the result of an examination.
"Get lost." Seris answered angrily and gathered her mana again, she felt like a pervert was staring at her right now.
Black Silence did not care, he raised his hands and looked at his own fingers.
At his forearm and then at Lian’s body.
"I could have used you too." The Calamity said with cold satisfaction and there was a strange excitement in his voice.
Seris attacked.
But Black Silence moved back this time, not because of fear but only to continue speaking.
"Are there many bodies like yours in your world?" His hunger was clear, even thinking about the world in front of him, a world that had such creatures and high-quality food, made him salivate.
"You know, you’re really disgusting." Seris said with disgust, the idea of a creature talking about humans as if they were prey and food was not pleasant at all.
"But among all those bodies, I doubt any of them are as good as this one...so why should I change it?" The Calamity said with the same smile and slowly opened and closed his fingers.
Seris paused for a moment and the time panel at the corner of her vision was going down.
But the next sentence made her forget even the passage of time for a moment.
"This is no longer a vessel." Black Silence said in an almost possessive tone and placed his hand on Lian’s chest.
"This body is mine." The satisfaction in his voice was more frightening than any threat.
Something cold went down inside Seris, she wanted to explode from anger, she had never wanted to kill something this badly!
Every word that came out of that mouth made her want even more to tear apart this damn creature, this bastard whose hobby was destroying worlds, with her own hands!
"I finally found a body that does not limit my hunger." The Calamity continued with a smile and the purple light in his eyes became stronger.
"A body that can grow."
"A body that can learn to devour."
The Young Pendragon got stuck on that same word for a moment.
Devour.
Something about that sentence was not normal, it was as if the Calamity was not only talking about his own power, as if he had found something inside Lian’s body that had even excited him.
Seris no longer wasted time and attacked again, but now her anger was even stronger.
"I said that body is not yours!" She attacked with an angry shout and sent her sword from the right.
Black Silence blocked the strike with his forearm, a deep cut appeared, blood came out but his smile did not disappear.
"It is now." He finally said simply

chapters.title: Chapter 377: Battle With The Calamity III
paragraphs: Seris clenched her teeth and put more power into her next strike, anger was burning her from the inside.
Every word was like gasoline that made her anger burn even stronger.
"With this body, this world will only be the beginning."
"Then the world behind it."
"And other worlds."
"Until there is nothing left to destroy." Black Silence finished the sentence with the same inhuman smile.
For a moment Seris truly had nothing to say, not because she was afraid, but because she had finally understood.
This creature had not chosen Lian’s body only because it was highly adaptable.
It was not just a good vessel.
From the Calamity’s point of view, this body was not an ending, it was a beginning, a body that could grow, learn, become stronger and perhaps even do what the Calamity did better than itself.
Devour.
She could not stop herself from thinking...what exactly was Lian that even an existence capable of destroying worlds praised his body?
Unfortunately, maybe she would never find an answer to that.
She gripped her sword tighter.
"Then I have to kill you even more than I thought." She said with cold anger and her body disappeared again.
This time all her attacks were meant to cause damage, not testing and not searching for signs of Lian and no more hesitation.
She was sure now...she had to kill this Calamity! Even if it meant destroying Lian’s body!
[Moonless Severance.]
[Thousand Petal swordstorm.]
[King’s Breaker.]
Three skills activated one after another.
Black Silence was forced to move several steps back and more lines appeared on Lian’s body.
Blood ran down his arm, a thin cut went from the side of his cheek to his jaw but none of them were deep, none of them truly threatened him.
And Seris’s time was quickly running out.
Black Silence suddenly increased his speed, to the point that Seris could not even fully see his movement.
His fist hit her stomach, her body bent and the air left her lungs, he grabbed her wrist, turned and slammed her into the ground.
Boom!
A crater formed under her body, the skill was still active, but her body had now started to break under its own pressure.
Seris immediately jumped out of the crater, raised her sword, she had no time left to waste.
She could only make one more strike!
Black Silence stood in front of her with the same disgusting smile.
[Heavenfall Execution]
She brought her sword down, the shadow of her sword suddenly became several times larger and it was like the sky itself had been split open.
It came down with the huge power flowing through it...but--
Lian caught it with his bare hand.
The pressure between them broke the ground and caused cracks to spread all around them.
Seris pushed with all her strength and a very weak cracking sound came from the bones of Lian’s fingers.
But—
The mana faded, everything suddenly became slow.
Her muscles started to hurt as if all their fibers had been torn apart, her legs trembled and her vision became blurry for a moment.
[Swordheart Override safe period has ended.]
[Warning: Severe physical damage, the body can no longer continue, if the skill remains active, it may lead to the collapse of the body and soul]
Black Silence was still holding her sword and with one kick, he sent her flying dozens of meters back.
Seris took a heavy breath, but she did not lower her gaze, even now, even after losing again there was still anger in her eyes.
Although she turned off Swordheart Override, she did not want to risk the collapse of her body and soul right now.
If she continued, she would last thirty more seconds at best and if she could not destroy the Calamity by then, she would die herself.
And she doubted she could kill this bastard in thirty seconds.
Although this did not mean that she had given up!
Black Silence seemed to find this resistance interesting, the smile was still on his face.
But several hundred meters away, someone else could not see that smile, he could only hear the words.
"This is no longer a vessel."
The voice of Black Silence repeated in Cindar’s mind.
"This body is mine."
For a moment he could not hear the battle around him, Darian had drawn his bow again, Tavern and several others were ready to attack from two sides.
The remaining chains were moving above the battlefield.
But Cindar’s mind was somewhere else.
This body is mine.
The sentence had no meaning for a few seconds, or perhaps he did not want to understand its meaning.
Then the memories of the past few days returned one after another, the moment Black Silence came out of the cocoon.
The four undead bowed, Cindar looked at him, the Calamity did not even turn his head toward him.
On the way to the Giant’s Graveyard, Cindar had tried several times to feel his presence through the old connection.
There was no response...
When the first chain broke, he congratulated him, but again there was no response...and that connection between the Anchor and the Calamity did not even work anymore.
It still existed, it still allowed Black Silence to remain in this world...but it had become one-sided.
Cindar had explained it to himself, perhaps the Calamity’s mind was not complete yet, perhaps it still could not speak.
Perhaps the incomplete transfer had caused its silence.
But now? No, it could speak, clearly and consciously and it was even enjoying itself, it just had not spoken to him, because it did not need to.
Finally, after hundreds of years, something like real coldness formed inside Cindar.
Mother...father...brother...lover...destroying the world...hatred...hundreds of years of planning...all his goals...and all the sacrifices and lives he had given...what were they all for?
For this moment.
Black Silence was supposed to be freed, it was supposed to eat the worlds again, it was supposed to grow stronger.

And in the end, it was supposed to return to him, to the first Anchor, Cindar was supposed to become the final vessel, the connection he received from Black Silence was supposed to give him enough power to break the law of death.
All those deaths, all the worlds that were supposed to be destroyed, all of them were only the price for bringing a few people back.
But now Black Silence had found a better vessel...this human.
No.
It did not even call him a "vessel", it called him its body, its own body, which meant that in the future Cindar had planned for hundreds of years, there was no longer a place for Cindar.
Something changed in his dry face and...he began to hate Black Silence.
Not because of the world, not because of the dead and not even because of the billions of creatures that were supposed to be eaten.
Because of himself, he had thought Black Silence was his tool, but now he understood that perhaps he had been the tool from the very beginning.
His father had used his grief, Black Silence had used his body and his world.
And in the end, he himself was also just a link in the chain of another creature’s goal and now that he no longer had any value...he was being thrown away.
Cindar clenched his teeth.
"No!!!" He could not accept something like this!
He kept his eyes fixed on Lian’s body.
Darian, who was ready to shoot, saw his mouth move for a moment, but the distance was too great and he could not hear the words that came out of his mouth.
Cindar put his hand on his chest, where something very old still existed.
The bond.
The First Anchor.
The relationship between him and the Black Silence had never been one-sided, the Calamity had entered this world through him.
It had taken his memories, touched his emotions, and used his existence to remain stable in this world.
But every Anchor was connected from both sides, and if the Black Silence was not willing to return to him according to the plan, he would force it.
He did not want to use this ability, because it could only be used once and he knew that if he used it, his relationship with the Calamity would be destroyed forever.
But he had no other choice, he needed to make the Black Silence understand that without him, it was nothing, the only reason that Calamity could remain in this world was because of him

chapters.title: Chapter 378: Battle With The Calamity IV
paragraphs: And now, by trying to cut the bond and expel it, he was trying to scare it enough that it would have no choice but to return to him.
He knew... he knew that for the Black Silence, which had not yet been able to return to its peak, this world was very important and it could not accept being expelled from it.
Because of that, it would surely be willing to abandon that human’s body and accept his body as its final vessel.
The plan to destroy the other worlds that he had made? He would either give up on it or find another way, but he could not just stand there and watch all his hopes and goals be destroyed.
A very old mark under the skin of Cindar’s chest lit up.

The light was black, but red lines flowed through its center, and when it activated, the bond began to be destroyed and unless it was stopped in the middle of the process, the bond would be destroyed and the Calamity would be expelled from the world.
The four undead slowed their movements for a moment.
The swordsman turned his head toward Cindar.
The root controller also stopped for a moment.
Even the mage lowered her hand for a moment.
The process of cutting the bond had begun.

Cindar smiled, not the satisfied smile from before but something more twisted, more possessive, he was going to take the Black Silence back, the grave of all his other plans... he could not allow the Calamity to leave him.
A black strand came out of his chest.
Then a second.
A third.
All of them stretched through the air, toward Lian.
Seris raised her sword again, her body was still shaking from the end of Swordheart Override but before she could attack—
Lian stopped and the evil smile on his face stayed still for a moment, then the purple light in his eyes trembled.
Seris frowned.
Black strands were pulled out from behind Lian’s body, toward the distance, toward Cindar.
His body resisted against something that was pulling out what was inside him, the smile on his face slowly disappeared.
Something appeared in his purple eyes that Seris had never seen from the Calamity until that moment, disbelief.
Cindar was holding his hand against his chest in the distance, black strands were stretched between them and a smile was on his dry face.
"You belong to me." he said in a quiet voice filled with possession and pressed his fingers against the mark on his chest.
[The process of cutting the Anchor and Calamity bond has begun.]
[After the process ends, the Calamity will be expelled from the world.]
More blackness was pulled out of Lian’s body.
[Expulsion: 3%]
The purple light in his eyes trembled.
[Expulsion: 7%]
Seris only watched for several seconds, even the battle around her became blurred.
The Black Silence slowly turned his head, very slowly, his gaze moved away from that girl and fixed on Cindar.
And for the first time since he had been born again, the Calamity truly looked at his First Anchor.
[Expulsion: 7%]
Seris stood still and watched the scene, the Calamity was staring at the Founder of the Cindari but that look was different from every normal look.
The Black Silence did not look at Cindar like an old servant, an important enemy or even an equal being.
That look was more like the look of a predator that had suddenly realized that a small insect had dared to pull its food out from between its teeth.
The ground under Lian’s feet cracked.
Not because of any movement from him, his presence had simply become heavier.
The pieces of ancient bones around him began to crack without anything touching them. A few seconds later, their surfaces collapsed and turned into white dust.
The sky above the graveyard also slowly became darker.
There were no clouds.
There was no shadow.
It was as if the light itself did not want to remain around that body.
Even the giant body of the Titan trembled for a moment, its fingers moved a few centimeters and the ground under everyone shook.
Seris narrowed her one healthy eye.
This was the first time.
The first time she truly saw the Black Silence angry.
Not human anger, not the anger of someone who wanted to shout, insult or break something.
It was the anger of a creature that believed nothing in the world had the right to resist its will.
The panel changed again.
[Expulsion: 9%]
The black strands became thicker, Lian’s body was pulled forward for a moment.
"What...are you doing?" the Black Silence said in a very low voice and something like hatred flowed through that familiar voice of Lian.
"I’m reminding you that you are only here because of me! You were freed because of me! And now you are acting like I’m no longer useful and you want to throw me away!" Cindar roared angrily.
This was perhaps the first argument that had ever happened between the two.
"This is the only warning I will give you! Abandon that human and accept me as your final vessel." he then added with madness.
Being chosen as the final vessel meant losing one’s awareness...or at least that was how it was for others.
He was sure that even after becoming the vessel, he could keep his awareness, he had prepared for this for all these years.
"You did something you should not have done." the Black Silence continued in a frighteningly calm voice and his gaze did not leave the mark on Cindar’s chest.
Cindar’s smile had still not disappeared, in fact, it may have become even deeper.
"Really?" he asked with clear mockery and pressed his fingers harder against the mark on his chest.
The dark strands trembled.
"I was the one who opened the way for you."
"I was the one who waited hundreds of years for you."
"I was the one who prepared this world for you."
"You belonged to me from the beginning." Cindar finished with a possessive tone.
"As long as you agree to abandon that human’s body, I will allow you to remain in this world."
For a moment, the entire graveyard became silent, even the sounds of the battles around them seemed farther away.
The Black Silence’s face did not change at all, but the ground under his feet suddenly sank several meters, the pressure of his presence passed through the area like an invisible wave.
Seris slid one step backward, One spread her legs wider, several Cindari farther away were forced to push their weapons into the ground to keep their balance.
Cindar still did not stop the process, he could not, all his focus was on the old Anchor, if he removed his hand from the mark, the expulsion would stop.
But the Black Silence was also in a strange situation, the strands were not only pulling darkness out of Lian’s body.
The bond was connected from both sides.
Every time the Black Silence tried to strengthen its existence inside Lian’s body with more force, the expulsion also became stronger for a moment.
If he released all his power and attacked Cindar directly, there was a risk that more of his existence would be pulled along that same bond.
And he could not kill the Anchor, as soon as he killed the Anchor, he would only be able to remain in this world for a short time and after that he would be expelled.
Rules were rules.
If he had been complete, if the part of him remaining in the Titan were released, he would not care about being expelled, even if he left this world, he could make his way to another world...Earth.
But it was still too early, he was still incomplete!
The two beings were trapped in a temporary deadlock.
Cindar could not fight, the Black Silence could not attack freely.
And Seris saw the chance, she had no idea why the relationship between these two had suddenly become hostile and why they were now against each other.
Of course, she did not care either, but she could not let the Calamity be expelled from this world, if it left this place, it would surely come after their world.
She had to kill the Calamity here!
Her eyes moved from the dark strands to the mark on Cindar’s chest.
The Anchor, this was what the system had mentioned, she did not know what an Anchor was, unlike Lian she had not seen the memories and she did not even have any information to use for reasoning.
But she also had no idea how she could forcefully stop the process, was such a thing even possible?
’Maybe if I kill Cindar, it will stop.’ she thought to herself, that was it, she felt that this might be the best way.
She turned her head toward the battlefield.
"Rindo! Cassian! Anyone who can hear me, kill Cindar!" Seris shouted with all her strength.
Unfortunately, she did not know that her idea was ridiculously wrong.

sentences.text: And now, by trying to cut the bond and expel it, he was trying to scare it enough that it would have no choice but to return to him.
He knew... he knew that for the Black Silence, which had not yet been able to return to its peak, this world was very important and it could not accept being expelled from it.
Because of that, it would surely be willing to abandon that human’s body and accept his body as its final vessel.
The plan to destroy the other worlds that he had made?
He would either give up on it or find another way, but he could not just stand there and watch all his hopes and goals be destroyed.
A very old mark under the skin of Cindar’s chest lit up.

The light was black, but red lines flowed through its center, and when it activated, the bond began to be destroyed and unless it was stopped in the middle of the process, the bond would be destroyed and the Calamity would be expelled from the world.
The four undead slowed their movements for a moment.
The swordsman turned his head toward Cindar.
The root controller also stopped for a moment.
Even the mage lowered her hand for a moment.
The process of cutting the bond had begun.

Cindar smiled, not the satisfied smile from before but something more twisted, more possessive, he was going to take the Black Silence back, the grave of all his other plans... he could not allow the Calamity to leave him.
A black strand came out of his chest.
Then a second.
A third.
All of them stretched through the air, toward Lian.
Seris raised her sword again, her body was still shaking from the end of Swordheart Override but before she could attack—
Lian stopped and the evil smile on his face stayed still for a moment, then the purple light in his eyes trembled.
Seris frowned.
Black strands were pulled out from behind Lian’s body, toward the distance, toward Cindar.
His body resisted against something that was pulling out what was inside him, the smile on his face slowly disappeared.
Something appeared in his purple eyes that Seris had never seen from the Calamity until that moment, disbelief.
Cindar was holding his hand against his chest in the distance, black strands were stretched between them and a smile was on his dry face.
"You belong to me." he said in a quiet voice filled with possession and pressed his fingers against the mark on his chest.
[The process of cutting the Anchor and Calamity bond has begun.]
[After the process ends, the Calamity will be expelled from the world.]
More blackness was pulled out of Lian’s body.
[Expulsion: 3%]
The purple light in his eyes trembled.
[Expulsion: 7%]
Seris only watched for several seconds, even the battle around her became blurred.
The Black Silence slowly turned his head, very slowly, his gaze moved away from that girl and fixed on Cindar.
And for the first time since he had been born again, the Calamity truly looked at his First Anchor.
[Expulsion: 7%]
Seris stood still and watched the scene, the Calamity was staring at the Founder of the Cindari but that look was different from every normal look.
The Black Silence did not look at Cindar like an old servant, an important enemy or even an equal being.
That look was more like the look of a predator that had suddenly realized that a small insect had dared to pull its food out from between its teeth.
The ground under Lian’s feet cracked.
Not because of any movement from him, his presence had simply become heavier.
The pieces of ancient bones around him began to crack without anything touching them.
A few seconds later, their surfaces collapsed and turned into white dust.
The sky above the graveyard also slowly became darker.
There were no clouds.
There was no shadow.
It was as if the light itself did not want to remain around that body.
Even the giant body of the Titan trembled for a moment, its fingers moved a few centimeters and the ground under everyone shook.
Seris narrowed her one healthy eye.
This was the first time.
The first time she truly saw the Black Silence angry.
Not human anger, not the anger of someone who wanted to shout, insult or break something.
It was the anger of a creature that believed nothing in the world had the right to resist its will.
The panel changed again.
[Expulsion: 9%]
The black strands became thicker, Lian’s body was pulled forward for a moment.
"What...are you doing?" the Black Silence said in a very low voice and something like hatred flowed through that familiar voice of Lian.
"I’m reminding you that you are only here because of me!
You were freed because of me!
And now you are acting like I’m no longer useful and you want to throw me away!" Cindar roared angrily.
This was perhaps the first argument that had ever happened between the two.
"This is the only warning I will give you!
Abandon that human and accept me as your final vessel." he then added with madness.
Being chosen as the final vessel meant losing one’s awareness...or at least that was how it was for others.
He was sure that even after becoming the vessel, he could keep his awareness, he had prepared for this for all these years.
"You did something you should not have done." the Black Silence continued in a frighteningly calm voice and his gaze did not leave the mark on Cindar’s chest.
Cindar’s smile had still not disappeared, in fact, it may have become even deeper.
"Really?" he asked with clear mockery and pressed his fingers harder against the mark on his chest.
The dark strands trembled.
"I was the one who opened the way for you."
"I was the one who waited hundreds of years for you."
"I was the one who prepared this world for you."
"You belonged to me from the beginning." Cindar finished with a possessive tone.
"As long as you agree to abandon that human’s body, I will allow you to remain in this world."
For a moment, the entire graveyard became silent, even the sounds of the battles around them seemed farther away.
The Black Silence’s face did not change at all, but the ground under his feet suddenly sank several meters, the pressure of his presence passed through the area like an invisible wave.
Seris slid one step backward, One spread her legs wider, several Cindari farther away were forced to push their weapons into the ground to keep their balance.
Cindar still did not stop the process, he could not, all his focus was on the old Anchor, if he removed his hand from the mark, the expulsion would stop.
But the Black Silence was also in a strange situation, the strands were not only pulling darkness out of Lian’s body.
The bond was connected from both sides.
Every time the Black Silence tried to strengthen its existence inside Lian’s body with more force, the expulsion also became stronger for a moment.
If he released all his power and attacked Cindar directly, there was a risk that more of his existence would be pulled along that same bond.
And he could not kill the Anchor, as soon as he killed the Anchor, he would only be able to remain in this world for a short time and after that he would be expelled.
Rules were rules.
If he had been complete, if the part of him remaining in the Titan were released, he would not care about being expelled, even if he left this world, he could make his way to another world...Earth.
But it was still too early, he was still incomplete!
The two beings were trapped in a temporary deadlock.
Cindar could not fight, the Black Silence could not attack freely.
And Seris saw the chance, she had no idea why the relationship between these two had suddenly become hostile and why they were now against each other.
Of course, she did not care either, but she could not let the Calamity be expelled from this world, if it left this place, it would surely come after their world.
She had to kill the Calamity here!
Her eyes moved from the dark strands to the mark on Cindar’s chest.
The Anchor, this was what the system had mentioned, she did not know what an Anchor was, unlike Lian she had not seen the memories and she did not even have any information to use for reasoning.
But she also had no idea how she could forcefully stop the process, was such a thing even possible?
’Maybe if I kill Cindar, it will stop.’ she thought to herself, that was it, she felt that this might be the best way.
She turned her head toward the battlefield.
"Rindo!
Cassian!
Anyone who can hear me, kill Cindar!" Seris shouted with all her strength.
Unfortunately, she did not know that her idea was ridiculously wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 379: A Fall Without Glory
paragraphs: "Are you sure?!" Rindo asked loudly while he held his weapon in front of the fist of another undead.
The metal bent under the pressure and he was pushed several steps back.
"No!" Seris answered harshly and started running herself, her eyes fixed on Cindar.
Was she sure her idea was correct? Of course not, how could she be sure about something like this?
But she could not let the Calamity be expelled from the world and besides, after seeing that Cindar could not move, this was the best chance to get rid of him.
"But this is the best chance we have right now!"
Of course, she first attacked the Black Silence, if she could kill this creature in this state too, that would be even better.
However, the Calamity easily dodged her attacks, and even the attacks that hit him could not leave even a scratch.
The Black Silence only defended and dodged, and could not attack, but it made no difference.
After that, she tried to attack him from other angles too, but after seeing that it was useless, she moved toward Cindar.
And after reaching him, she moved her sword behind her body and prepared to strike.
Darian also changed his focus from a distance, the Seven-Colored Sky Bow was lowered in his hand.
Now it rose again, the bowstring was pulled, and the seven lights gathered around it.
Tavern had also heard Seris’s voice, his face, which had been broken from the moment he saw the Founder, now showed nothing but cold anger.
Cindar noticed it, his eyes left Lian for a moment.
Seris was getting closer, Darian was preparing his arrow, Rindo was leaving his battle and Tavern had raised his sword.
Cindar could not move his hand away from his chest, something like real anxiety appeared on his face.
His head turned toward the four undead.
"Stop them." He ordered in a cold voice.
But no one moved, the swordsman stood several dozen meters away.
The Root Controller stood among a wave of broken roots.
The Cindari mage was still standing among steam and fire with his half-destroyed body.
And the Cindari Big had also stopped his attack for a moment.
The four only looked at him.
"I said stop them." Cindar raised his voice this time while keeping the pressure on the seal on his chest.
Again, there was no movement and they completely ignored him, something changed in his eyes, disbelief and then anger.
"I gave you an order!" he shouted.
But again there was only silence, the four undead took their eyes away from him.
Slowly, almost at the same time, they turned them toward Lian, this simple movement was enough and Cindar understood.
Years ago, when he was still controlling everything from inside the coffin and the hidden network of the later generations, he had allowed the story of the "Father" to take shape.
Not because of faith but because of necessity, every generation needed something greater than itself to worship.

Something that would tell them that protecting the tree and the process of transferring the Calamity from the Titan to the tree and preparing the return of the Black Silence was not only a political duty.
It was a sacred duty and after generations passed, the story became a belief, the belief became a ritual and the ritual became worship.
Above the Founder...was the Father.
And the Black Silence was one of the Father’s children.
For the first time, Cindar saw the real result of something he himself had planted, those four creatures did not serve him.
When they were forced to choose between the Founder and the Father’s Child, their choice had already been decided.
"I created you!" He shouted with broken anger and for a moment even the focus of his seal shook.
There was no answer, not a single word, no bow and not even a look, the swordsman only turned his face completely toward the Black Silence.
And the others also looked at the Calamity so they could hear his order, but he said nothing, and did not try to stop Cindar’s death...as if a new idea had come to his mind.
This silence was more humiliating than any other answer.
The tradition Cindar had created to control generations had now become his own nightmare.
At that moment Darian released the bowstring.
Fisssh!
A line of seven-colored light crossed the battlefield.
Cindar saw it from the corner of his eye, raised his free hand, and invisible pressure formed.
The arrow was deflected two meters away from his body, but this time the defense was not complete.
The seven-colored light passed beside his shoulder, tore away part of his dried flesh and ancient armor, and dark blood came out of his body.
And this one second was enough for Seris.
[Moonless Severance.]
A cutting line appeared directly on Cindar’s neck, he moved his head back, and the cut only opened the surface of his skin.
But before he could release another wave of pressure, Tavern arrived from behind, his sword went directly into Cindar’s side.
He turned his body, and instead of his heart, the blade passed through his side.
More blood came out and Tavern gritted his teeth.
"That was it?!" Cindar looked at him with hatred and released another wave of invisible pressure from his body.
Tavern blocked it with his sword in front of himself, but he was still thrown several meters back.
Rindo entered from the other side, his sword struck the thigh of the Cindari Founder and created a deep wound.
Cindar struck with his free hand, Rindo rolled on the ground, but before he could stand up, two other Cindari who had been ready with Tavern also attacked their own Founder.
For several seconds, something broke in Cindar’s expression, people from the race he himself had created were trying to kill him.
"Ungrateful..." He said angrily and released another wave of invisible pressure around him.
One of the Cindari was thrown into the air, his armor broke and the other fell onto one knee.
But the attack did not stop, Darian raised his bow again, and light gathered.
Seris approached from the left.
Tavern pulled himself up from the dirt.
Cindar looked at all of them, he had to fight several enemies at the same time while using a large part of his power on the Anchor.
Should he let it go? But he knew that even if he let it go, nothing would change, the Black Silence was angry with him!
And the moment the process stopped, the Calamity would attack him!
Even if it did not kill him, it would certainly seal and imprison him so he could no longer cause any trouble...and he could not let that happen.
If the process went further toward completion...the Calamity would certainly have no choice but to surrender! And then he would win.
He just had to endure a little longer...just a little more.
[Expulsion: 12%]
The black strands between him and Lian became stronger.
The Black Silence was motionless, but the pressure of his presence became stronger every second and at that moment a huge sound came from behind.
BOOOOOOM!
One of the Titan’s remaining chains broke, and the entire battlefield shook for a moment.
Part of the darkness stored inside the Titan immediately started to come out, but because the expulsion process was still active, the flow of darkness was pulled between the two points.
Lian.
Cindar.
This pressure from both sides caused another chain to make a cracking sound.
Crack... crack...
The Black Silence looked at it and a smile appeared on his face again...his idea had worked and these fools were helping him without even knowing it.
Seraphina vomited blood in the distance, the four lines of light connected to the chains shook for a moment.
[Time remaining for the final command: 03:17]
She fell to one knee, but did not lower her hands.
"Not yet..." She said under her breath through clenched teeth and kept the flow of mana.
Cindar saw all of this, but he could not stop the process, if he stopped it now, everything would be over.
Centuries of planning, all the sacrifices, his goal, everything would be over!
So he kept it going.
Even when Seris attacked him again.
Even when Rindo came from the right side.
Even when Darian prepared his next arrow.
Tavern pulled himself up from the ground, blood was running from the corner of his lips, but there was no sign of doubt in his eyes anymore.
Cindar looked at him for a moment, his old pride returned to his face.
"You owe your existence to me." He said with contempt and raised his free hand.
"No, you abandoned us! Did you forget?" Tavern answered in a calm voice.
Cindar’s eyes opened slightly wider for a moment.
"We built our cities ourselves." Tavern said and gripped his sword tighter.
"We raised our children ourselves."
"We survived our wars ourselves."
"You only created us so you could use us." He then looked directly into the Founder’s eyes.
And then he attacked, Cindar released the invisible pressure, but at the same moment Darian released his arrow.
The seven colors gathered at one point, and the explosion of light directly hit the invisible pressure shield.
His defense finally broke and his body was completely open for half a second.
Tavern arrived, his sword went directly into his side and the blade came out from his back.
Cindar opened his mouth, dark blood came out, but he was not finished yet.
Rindo entered from the other side and struck his sword into Cindar’s free arm with all his strength, the bone broke and the arm hung down.
But he still did not release the seal on his chest.
Seris moved forward, everything slowed for a moment in her eyes.
Cindar turned around.
There was something in his eyes that she had never seen before.
Fear.
Fear of death.
Fear of failure.
Fear that all the centuries he had waited would become nothing, and at that moment he finally took his hand away from the seal, he had no other choice.
But Seris did not care, and it was already too late, and she swung her sword.
[Heavenfall Execution.]
The movement of the blade was short, but a huge wave of energy was released and a thin line passed through Cindar’s neck.
His head tilted slightly and a red line appeared on his neck, his eyes were still open, as if he himself still could not believe it.
Then his head separated from his body.
Slowly.
Without glory.
Without a final word.
The body of the man who had sold a world and sacrificed generations stood like that for a moment.
Then the seal on his chest went dark, the black strands broke and Cindar’s body fell to its knees and then onto the ground.
[The First Anchor has been destroyed.]
His head stopped several meters away on the ground, his eyes were still open, but there was nothing left behind them.
Seris only looked at the body for several seconds.
That was it?
This man had caused all of this.

The destruction of the world, the destruction of civilizations, the death of the Forgotten Tree, the return of the Calamity...all of it was his fault and now there was only a headless body on the ground.
Seris felt no satisfaction, not even happiness, only a cold feeling.
It was over.
But at that moment, a panel opened in front of Seris’s eyes.
[The hidden condition of the Evolution Quest has been discovered.]
[To kill a Calamity, both stabilization points must be destroyed.]
[Anchor]
[Vessel]
[Evolution Quest: Kill the Calamity.]
[Completion condition: 1/2]
[The Calamity’s Anchor has been destroyed.]

chapters.title: Chapter 380: Battle With The Calamity V
paragraphs: [To completely destroy a Calamity, both stabilization points must be destroyed.]
[Anchor]
[Vessel]
[Evolution Quest: Kill a Calamity.]
[Calamity Destruction Condition: 1/2]
[The Calamity’s Anchor has been destroyed.]
[Warning! The Anchor has been destroyed and the Black Silence can remain in this world for a maximum of ten minutes, unless it finds a new Anchor.]
For several seconds, Seris did not move, the sounds of the battlefield became distant to her.
Anchor.
Vessel.
Cindar was the Anchor, so what was the other one? There was no need to think, her head slowly rose and her eyes fixed on Lian.
The same body, the same face, the same purple eyes, Lian was the Vessel, a truth that caused a strange pressure to form in her chest.
The feeling was so heavy that it silenced all her other feelings.
"So that’s how it is..." She said in a very low voice and tightened her fingers around the sword’s handle.
To kill the Calamity, both the Anchor and the Vessel had to be destroyed.
The Anchor was dead and now only one remained, Lian, she had already made her decision, so there was no place to back down.
And she looked at the last notification.
[Warning! The Anchor has been destroyed and the Black Silence can remain in this world for a maximum of ten minutes, unless it finds a new Anchor.]
She only had ten minutes, if she did not finish the Black Silence within these ten minutes, the Calamity would escape from them and would probably enter their world.
This was not something she could allow, they had seen that the Calamity could spread corruption and madness just by being present and moving around in the world.
On the other side, the Black Silence did not even look at Cindar’s corpse, not even once and as soon as the strands were cut, his strange anger also disappeared.
Lian’s face returned to that same absolute coldness.
As if the thing that had managed to truly anger the Calamity a few moments ago was no longer even worth a look.
Cindar was dead, the problem had been removed.
That was all.
But he knew that he did not have much time and would soon be expelled from this world because he no longer had an Anchor, the Black Silence turned back toward the chains.
And this indifference was Cindar’s final humiliation, the man who had sold his entire world for this creature, even his death was not important to it.
The four undead remained motionless for several seconds, the swordsman raised his sword again, the Root Controller placed his foot on the ground.
The Cindari mage gathered his mana and the other one also took a guard position, they were still following the Black Silence.
Seraphina’s panel flashed at that moment.
[Time remaining for the Seal Command: 02:41]
Rindo took a heavy breath.
"It isn’t over yet!" He shouted as a warning and raised his sword again.
At that moment, a terrible sound came from the direction of the Titan.
BOOOOOOM!
The chain that had cracked earlier finally collapsed.
The huge rings fell onto the ground and a wave of dust spread for hundreds of meters.
Now only two chains remained, the Titan moved more and its huge arm rose a few centimeters from the ground.
But even those few centimeters caused the rocks on it to collapse.
[Corrupted Titan Awakening: 89%]
Seris turned toward Lian.
The Black Silence had placed his hand on one of the two remaining chains, the seals on the chain were already cracked.
Seris immediately moved.
"I won’t let you!" She shouted angrily and ran toward him.
She raised her sword, but before she could reach him—
Crack.
The first crack.
Crack.
The second.
Her sword moved toward Lian’s arm but the Black Silence only moved his wrist aside, the blade passed just a few centimeters from his skin.
His other hand was still on the chain, Seris struck a second time and this time the Calamity deflected the blade with his palm.
Without even looking at her.
"How dare you!!" Seris growled angrily and attacked again, this bastard was completely ignoring her, it was clear that he knew he might leave this world at any moment.
That was why he was using all his power to break the chains faster and finally take back the part of himself that was imprisoned.
BOOOOOOM!
The chain broke.
A wave of light and darkness came out from the broken point and the Young Pendragon slid several meters back.
[One chain remains.]
[Corrupted Titan Awakening: 94%]
Only the final chain remained, the only thing that was still keeping the Titan completely tied to the ground.
The Black Silence moved toward it and Seris immediately followed him, this time their battle was different.
The Calamity no longer wanted to fight her, he did not see her as a worthy enemy but only as an annoyance.
She activated [Moonless Severance].
A cutting line appeared on Lian’s shoulder and he raised his hand and changed the direction of the cutting path, he did not even stop his step.
Seris came close again.
[King’s Breaker.]
The attack went directly toward his knee joint and the Black Silence moved his lower leg a few centimeters aside, the sword passed beside it.
His hand landed on the girl’s shoulder and he applied huge pressure, that was all, but Seris felt all the bones in her shoulder being crushed and she was thrown several meters back.
The expression on her face changed badly and pain filled her body, she could no longer feel one of her arms from the shoulder.
Before falling, she stabbed the sword into the ground and used it to hold herself up.
The Calamity continued walking, he did not care about Seris at all, this behavior suppressed her even more than before, as if she was not even worth fighting.
She stood up.
[Thousand Petal Swordstorm.]
Dozens of cuts went toward Lian, he dodged some of them, some hit his body and several lines of blood appeared on his skin.
But he did not even turn his head and only continued toward the final chain.
Seris breathed out harshly and gripped her sword tighter.
The mission panel was still in the corner of her vision.
[Calamity Destruction Condition: 1/2]
[Remaining Target: Vessel.]
Every time she saw it, her eyes unconsciously moved to Lian’s back, if there was no other way, she had to kill him.
This was no longer a guess, the system had directly said it.
She ran and her sword fell onto Lian’s shoulder, the Black Silence pushed it away with a simple movement.
"Lian!" She shouted and her voice spread across the cemetery.
She attacked again.
"If even a little of you is still in there..." Seris said with anger mixed with a pressure she did not want to call fear, and struck again.
The Black Silence placed his hand on the final chain and there was no reaction from the real Lian.
Seris made a third attack.
"Now is the time to do something!" She almost growled and sent her blade toward his hand.
The Black Silence moved his wrist aside, his fingers returned to the chain.
There was no pause, no tremble, no sign and no hesitation.
The anger inside the Young Pendragon became stronger for a moment, from anger, from the helplessness she hated more than anything.
She almost never asked anyone for help, if she had a problem, she solved it herself, if there was an enemy, she killed it herself, if she was wounded, she stood up herself.
But now she raised her sword again.
"Help me, damn it!" She shouted with all her strength and for the first time her voice was not only anger, there was also something like a plea inside it.
She did not want help to kill Lian...she only wanted help to know if some part of Lian was still alive! If some part of him was still inside there.
But Lian gave no answer and the final chain started to glow, this time its light was different.
Hundreds-of-years-old runes carved into the metal lit up one after another.
For a moment, unclear shapes could even be seen around the chain.
The remains of those who had given their lives years ago and turned them into seals.
Seraphina suddenly vomited blood in the distance, one of the lines of light connected to the chains went out.
Then the second.
[Time remaining for the Seal Command: 00:38]
She almost fell onto both knees, Liana pulled herself toward her.
"Seraphina!" She shouted with worry and grabbed her arm.
"Let go of me!" Seraphina roughly pushed her hand away. She spoke between broken breaths and pushed both hands forward again.
The remaining light trembled.
"Not yet...it’s not over."
Rindo tried to make his way toward Seris and Lian.
But that Cindari fell in front of him.
The swordsman blocked Tavern’s path.
The Root Controller brought huge roots out of the ground, the four undead were now doing everything they could to stop anyone from reaching the Black Silence.
Darian raised his bow from a distance, seven-colored light gathered and the arrow was fired toward Lian.
The swordsman moved, his blade deflected the line of light and the explosion happened in the distance.
"Damn..." Darian said coldly and pulled the bowstring again.
Seris was the only one left beside Lian, she held the sword with both hands and put all her remaining mana into the blade.
The attack went directly toward Lian’s hand, although the Black Silence caught the sword without hesitation and grabbed the girl by the neck, he stared at her with eyes empty of all emotion.
"You are an annoyance." He raised his hand and slapped her very hard across the face.
The slap was so strong that the skin and flesh on the right side of the girl’s face were completely torn apart and covered in blood and she vomited blood.
Then he threw her away like trash and also held her sword in his hand, after looking at it, he crushed it and threw it away.
"Now it is time to end this"
