chapters.title: Chapter 381: Battle With The Calamity ( Final )
paragraphs: Suddenly, light filled everything.
White and golden, so intense that no one could see anything for a moment and the entire cemetery was drowned in that light.
Then—
Crack.
A small sound that was almost funny compared to the huge chain, but everyone heard it.
"No..." Seraphina whispered in a very low voice, she realized that the Last Command skill had also completely shut down.
The crack on the last ring spread.
One meter.
Ten meters.
The entire surface of the chain and then—
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The last seal collapsed, a wave of force swallowed the entire area.
Seris was lifted off the ground, One threw himself in front of her and the ant’s body was thrown several meters back.
Tavern fell to the ground, Rindo stabbed his sword into the dirt and Darian put one knee on the ground.
The four moving corpses were also forced to move back.
[Warning.]
[All seals have been destroyed.]
[Corrupted Titan Awakening: 100%]
[The Corrupted Titan has awakened.]
For one second nothing happened--
Then the eye opened.
The Titan’s eye was so huge that from the group’s distance it looked more like a black lake than the eye of a living creature.
The pupil moved, the ground started to rise.
It was not shaking, it was as if the ground itself was rising, the rocks that had gathered on the Titan’s body for centuries fell from its shoulder and chest.
Part of the mountain collapsed, its huge hand slowly separated from the ground and then the Titan roared.
The sound did not only enter their ears, it entered their bones!
Seris felt her entire chest shaking from inside, the dirt under their feet moved like a wave and in the distance, beasts and monsters fled from the cemetery.
Of course, many of the monsters in the Giant Cemetery had already been killed by the five Cindari, including the Warden that had chased Lian and Seris in the past.
And now the remaining ones also fled in fear.
The roar passed through the Giant Forest.
It reached Glacethorn.
It went farther and even reached Emberroot, and the walls of Vhalaris shook.
The sky moved like the surface of water for a moment, some Awakened fell to the ground and covered their ears.
But Black Silence only watched.
There was no fear, no surprise and not even clear satisfaction in his eyes, as if everything that was happening was exactly what he had expected.
The Titan moved its huge head, its black eye fell on Lian’s small body, its giant hand rose.
Maybe to attack.
Maybe it was only the remaining instinct of a guardian that had been buried under corruption for years.
But Black Silence did not wait, Lian’s body separated from the ground, a mass of darkness formed under his feet and carried him toward the Titan’s head.
Seris wanted to move but the pressure from the Titan’s presence almost forced her onto her knees.
"Lian!" she shouted angrily and tried to move forward.
It was useless.
Black Silence landed on the Titan’s huge forehead, a human standing on the head of a creature that was like a mountain.
His hand rose and slowly touched the Titan’s cracked black skin.
He only whispered one word.
"Return." But that one word was more than enough.

The Titan suddenly froze and one moment later darkness came out of its body, first from its eye, then from the cracks in its skin, from its huge veins, from its chest, from its mouth and simply from its entire body, billions of dark strands were pulled into the air.
There were so many that the sky could not be seen for several seconds.
They all moved toward one point.
Lian.
Black Silence was taking himself back, the parts that had remained trapped inside the Titan for years.
The Titan roared, but this time its voice was different, the roar was not anger...it was pain.
Pain that had lasted for hundreds of years was passing through its body in one moment, darkness came out of its huge eye.
The color of its pupil slowly changed, black to gray and then to a lighter color.
After centuries, there was something in that eye that looked like real awareness.
Not madness, not corruption but tiredness, only tiredness, the guardian of the Primordial Root had finally returned, it had finally gotten its awareness back.
But its freedom did not mean salvation, as soon as the last dark strands left the Titan’s body, its huge skin started to dry.
At first there were only a few cracks, then hundreds and the muscles under its skin shrank, the limbs that had been like mountains only moments ago became thin at a terrifying speed.
Seris watched in shock.
"What is happening?" Liana asked in shock while holding the half-conscious Seraphina.
Aren looked at the Titan from a distance.

In fact, everyone was looking at that scene, the battle had stopped and the four Cindari who had regained their ability to fly were standing in the sky and acting like a wall, not allowing any of these humans to disturb their master.
And now everyone was looking at whether the Titan was...dying?
The Primordial Root no longer existed, it had been destroyed thousands of years ago, its remains, the Forgotten Tree, was also dead now.
The Titan had always depended on that life network, as the guardian of the Primordial Root, after the death of the purpose of its life, it had no reason to stay alive anymore.
The only thing that had kept this creature alive after the destruction of the Root and centuries of imprisonment was the corruption of Black Silence.
The same thing that had imprisoned it, the same thing that had broken its mind, that same thing had also stopped its body from completely dying.
And now it was gone.
The Titan opened its eye one last time, its gaze was no longer black, it was calm, tired and for a fraction of a second, something like relief could be seen in it.
Then its eyelid closed, its huge body collapsed and the creature that had finally been allowed to die after hundreds of years.
Its head fell to the ground.
BOOOOOOM!
The entire cemetery shook, a wave of dust rose into the sky.
And above it, Lian was still floating, the last dark strand entered his body, this time the reaction was nothing like the previous times.
His body suddenly rose several meters higher, his back bent, his fingers opened and the purple light in his eyes changed into something almost white-purple.

A huge shadow appeared behind his body, not a human shadow but something much larger...its shape was not stable, for a moment it looked like a huge mouth and the next moment something like long horns, then maybe wings.
But no one could remember its real shape, every time someone focused their eyes on it, its shape changed.
It was as if the minds of living creatures were simply not made to understand the true appearance of Black Silence.
Several very thin black lines appeared for a moment on Lian’s neck and hands, but his body was still the same body.
Lian’s face, Lian’s hands, Lian’s human body and only the presence behind it was no longer something that could be called human.
A huge panel appeared in front of everyone.
[Black Silence has been completed.]
[All parts of the Calamity have merged with the Host.]
[Complete manifestation has begun.]
[Warning! Main Quest has failed.]
Seris’s eyes stayed on the panel for a moment and then another panel appeared only in front of her.
[Calamity Destruction Condition: 1/2]
[Remaining Target: Host.]
Her gaze slowly moved down, onto Lian.
There was no Anchor left, the Titan was dead and all of Black Silence was gathered inside one body.
If the system was correct, only one thing remained to destroy the Calamity now.
Kill the Host.
Kill Lian.
"I don’t like this situation..." she said very quietly and no one could understand whether most of her anger was toward the Calamity or toward the situation that was forcing her to do this.
The white-purple light of Lian’s eyes shone through the dust, the huge shadow behind him spread wider, everyone thought that Black Silence had won.
Cindar was dead, the seven chains had been broken, the Titan had awakened and then been emptied of its corruption.
All the scattered parts of the Calamity were now gathered inside one body, exactly what Black Silence wanted.
But Seris did not know.
Rindo did not know.
No one knew.
Even Black Silence itself did not know.
Gathering all the parts of the Calamity inside one body, breaking the seals and completing Black Silence was not only the Calamity’s wish.
It was also what the true Lian wanted!

A huge shadow appeared behind his body, not a human shadow but something much larger...its shape was not stable, for a moment it looked like a huge mouth and the next moment something like long horns, then maybe wings.
But no one could remember its real shape, every time someone focused their eyes on it, its shape changed.
It was as if the minds of living creatures were simply not made to understand the true appearance of Black Silence.
Several very thin black lines appeared for a moment on Lian’s neck and hands, but his body was still the same body.
Lian’s face, Lian’s hands, Lian’s human body and only the presence behind it was no longer something that could be called human.
A huge panel appeared in front of everyone.
[Black Silence has been completed.]
[All parts of the Calamity have merged with the Host.]
[Complete manifestation has begun.]
[Warning!
Main Quest has failed.]
Seris’s eyes stayed on the panel for a moment and then another panel appeared only in front of her.
[Calamity Destruction Condition: 1/2]
[Remaining Target: Host.]
Her gaze slowly moved down, onto Lian.
There was no Anchor left, the Titan was dead and all of Black Silence was gathered inside one body.
If the system was correct, only one thing remained to destroy the Calamity now.
Kill the Host.
Kill Lian.
"I don’t like this situation..." she said very quietly and no one could understand whether most of her anger was toward the Calamity or toward the situation that was forcing her to do this.
The white-purple light of Lian’s eyes shone through the dust, the huge shadow behind him spread wider, everyone thought that Black Silence had won.
Cindar was dead, the seven chains had been broken, the Titan had awakened and then been emptied of its corruption.
All the scattered parts of the Calamity were now gathered inside one body, exactly what Black Silence wanted.
But Seris did not know.
Rindo did not know.
No one knew.
Even Black Silence itself did not know.
Gathering all the parts of the Calamity inside one body, breaking the seals and completing Black Silence was not only the Calamity’s wish.
It was also what the true Lian wanted!

chapters.title: Chapter 382: The Ruined Heart
paragraphs: Lian did not know how many days he had been dead.
Or maybe this was not death either.
Because dead people should not be able to think.

It was dark around him, but it was not the kind of darkness caused by the absence of light. There was nothing here for light to fall on at all, no ground, no sky, no walls and not even a distance that could be used to say that something was near or far.

He could not see his hands, because he had no hands, he had no legs and he could not even breathe, because he could not feel anything called lungs. He was not even sure if he still had a face that could open its eyes.
The only thing that remained was thought.
And that was enough to know that he still existed.
Lian remained floating in that darkness for an unknown amount of time. Maybe hours, maybe days; the concept of time had become almost meaningless in a place where he had no body.
Even so, he was not completely separated from the outside world, he could hear sounds, very far away and muffled, sometimes like someone was speaking from behind several thick walls.
Sometimes he felt pain, of course it was not his own pain, but the pain of his body, a body that was no longer under his control.
Everything that Black Silence saw, heard or touched through that body, a very weak part of it also reached Lian.
At first the images were so unclear that it was hard to understand them.
A shadow.
A movement in the light.
A feeling of the ground under his feet.
The pressure of the wind on his skin.
Then they slowly became clearer, and he understood, his body still existed, it was just no longer his.
The last thing he clearly remembered was not darkness.
It was hunger.
A hunger that was not his own.
When Black Silence started eating him inside the cocoon, Lian had not even realized what exactly was happening at first.
There were no teeth, there was no pain like his flesh being torn apart but things were disappearing from him.
First, unimportant things, the name of an alley that he had passed through once years ago.
The face of a man he had once seen in a store, the taste of a food he had liked when he was a child.
A moment later he knew he had forgotten something, but he could no longer even understand what it had been.
Then the bigger memories started.
The Academy, the day his Awakening had failed, the sound of the laughter of those who had looked at him after his failed Awakening.
Names.
Faces.
Parts of his family.
Liana, Seraphina, Seris, One and every time a part of them became weaker.
Lian had tried to hold on to them, but how could he hold onto something when he had no hands, no control over his mind or even full control over his own thoughts?
Black Silence did not steal memories, he ate them and that was the difference, anything he ate no longer remained anywhere.
In the end, something even more basic started to disappear...the feeling that "I" existed.
He was no longer sure why he was resisting, why he should preserve something, why disappearing was bad.
Then the last word that remained in the middle of the collapse of his mind started to break.
Lian.
Vorhelm.
His own name.
Its letters slowly lost their meaning one after another, its complete disappearance meant his absolute death, and right at that moment—
[Warning.]
[The Host’s identity is on the verge of complete collapse.]
Lian had almost not noticed that message at the time, not because it had not appeared, but because there was almost nothing left of him that could understand why it was important.
Then the second message came.
[Anomaly detected.]
And then something deep inside his existence reacted.
Not a soul, not a class and not any legendary artifact, but something that even he did not know existed.
[Ruined Heart activated.]
And the world collapsed.
Lian could never understand exactly what had happened later.
He had only felt that a very small part of what was still "him" had suddenly moved out of Black Silence’s reach.
It was like a city where everything was being eaten, and the last building had sunk into the ground before the collapse and was hidden under thousands of meters of rock.
Black Silence continued, he ate the remaining memories, searched for the threads of his identity but found nothing.
Because what remained of Lian was no longer in the same place as before.
He had fallen inside something else, something closed, something that the Calamity could not see.
And there he had been able to think again.
It had taken a long time for him to understand what had saved him, at first he had only seen its name.
Ruined Heart.
It was familiar but very unclear, like a name you had seen once years ago and immediately forgotten.
Then a memory of a very distant place rose in his mind.
Blood.
Stone.
Pain.
A fallen wolf that had died several meters away, the Ruined Realm, the first day he had been summoned there.
Lian saw the same scene again, his body had been pierced, he had lost a lot of blood, his breathing had become difficult.
But behind all that pain, the system panels had appeared one after another, his first Awakening had failed years ago, he had been sixteen at the time.
He had lived for two full years with that "Failure" mark.
His second attempt at the Academy had also failed, according to the known rules, this should have been the end, more than two attempts at Awakening was not something that was supposed to happen.
But that day in the Ruined Realm, the system had tried again.
The third attempt.
And that had also failed.
The memory of the panel in front of Lian’s mind became clearer.
[Awakening process started.]
[Failure.]
[Third attempt failed.]
At that time, he had barely remained conscious, even then, part of his mind had understood that this was the end.
If he had failed three times, what else could remain? The fact that he had managed to attempt Awakening three times was already remarkable.
But then a panel appeared that, among the blood, pain and chaos, he had almost paid no attention to.
[Ruined Heart activated.]
[Fourth Awakening started.]
Something that should not have existed.
The fourth attempt.
And then—
[Awakening successful.]
[Class: Monster.]
For a few moments, no thought formed in Lian’s mind and then a very simple sentence passed through the darkness.
"So it was you." he said inside his own mind and focused his attention on the thing surrounding his existence.
The entire day of his Awakening in the Ruined Realm suddenly had a different meaning, he had thought that the system had somehow given him another chance.
But no.
The system had not even started the fourth attempt until something called the Ruined Heart had activated.
Why?
Lian had no potential and even three attempts at Awakening had failed.
So how had this thing made Awakening possible?
And why was the result the Monster class?
A class that no one had ever heard of, a class that had no place in the normal structure of the Awakened.
Lian thought about his strange condition.
Race: Human.
Class: Monster.
Two things that had been placed together from the very first day, without him really knowing the reason.
Maybe the answer had been there from the beginning.
The Ruined Heart.
But the answer to one question only created ten more questions.
What was this thing? Since when had it been inside him? Since birth? Had someone put it inside him?
Was it related to the Vorhelm family? Or had it not been related to his family at all?
If it had existed inside his body from the beginning, why had it never reacted until that day?
And more importantly, why did the system have no information about it?
Lian tried to check the same name.
[Ruined Heart]
[Information unavailable.]
He tried again and this time a different message appeared.
[The identity of this entity is not registered in the system.]
It was not registered.
The system had names for Monsters, it had names for Calamities, it had information about creatures from other worlds.
Even Black Silence, although much of its information was hidden or incomplete, could be identified.
But the thing inside Lian did not even have an identity.
"Great, you don’t even know what the hell is inside my body and I have been living with it this whole time?." Lian said dryly inside his mind.

He was not ungrateful toward this thing, after all, it had caused his Awakening and now it had saved him too, but the feeling that something unknown was living inside him was not exactly pleasant either.
He looked around, he was currently in the place where the Heart was located and slowly the image of the thing protecting him became clearer.
It was not a heart.
At least not a heart made of flesh and blood.
In the dark space inside his existence, something huge and broken was there.
A black heart, its surface was full of cracks and parts of it looked like they had broken centuries ago and then been joined together again.
A very weak light flowed inside the cracks, not white, not golden, but a color that Lian could not clearly identify.
And on the walls of the Heart, five dents could be seen, five dents that looked more like places for something to be placed inside.
And he was inside it, or maybe a part of his existence had been stored inside it.
An invisible boundary existed around the Heart, outside that boundary, Black Silence was everywhere.
At first, the young Vorhelm could only feel its presence.
But now that the Calamity had been completed, for the first time he could see its reality and true face, and what he saw looked nothing like a human body.

chapters.title: Chapter 383: Death as a Plan
paragraphs: The true form of that thing, that Calamity, was beyond anything he could imagine, more precisely, the human mind was simply not capable of imagining something like this.
The space around the Ruined Heart had turned into an ocean of darkness, but an ocean without a surface, without an up or down.
Inside it, mouths opened that were not connected to any head or body, some were small and some were so large that even the Ruined Heart looked tiny compared to them.
Eyes opened and closed at impossible distances.
Some beside each other.
Some inside each other.
Some in places where Lian’s mind could not understand exactly where they were and something that looked like wings was spread through the darkness.
But anything that looked like a feather was actually a crack leading to another darkness.
Horns came out of it, but not in directions that should have been possible in normal space.
Every time Lian tried to understand its complete shape, the image changed, not because the creature was moving, but because his mind was unable to understand all of it at once.
And at the center of that shapeless monster was his human body.
Small and limited, a shell of flesh and bones that something of such great size had compressed itself inside.
He finally understood why the shadow that had appeared behind his body changed its shape every moment.
Those outside were only seeing random parts of the Calamity’s true form.
A mouth.
A wing.
A horn.
An eye.
But none of them were really that, they were only the mind’s attempt to give meaning to something it should not be seeing.
Lian turned his attention back to the Ruined Heart, masses of darkness had come toward it many times.

Every time they got close to the boundary, the space between them collapsed, as if the path itself was being destroyed, part of the darkness moved toward the heart and suddenly there was no longer a "way" to reach it.
A few moments later, the space around it formed again, Black Silence tried again, it failed again but apparently it did not even realize that something was there.
That was the strangest part.
The Ruined Heart had not only protected Lian, it had hidden him.
He looked at the broken heart for some time.
"What exactly are you?" he asked in his mind, even though he did not expect any answer.
There was no answer, of course and only the weak light inside the cracks of the heart pulsed once.
His gaze fell on the five indentations, exactly as if something was supposed to be placed there to fill them.
But what?...Calamities?
In any case, after being saved, it did not take long for Lian to be able to see the outside.
The first clear image was Seris, when they were still beside the Forgotten Tree and the Calamity had just come out of the cocoon.
She was lying injured on the ground, then One, who was crawling toward her body.
Then Black Silence raised his hand and he understood what he wanted to do.
A strike.
And that was the first time Lian had resisted, he had pushed everything that remained of himself against the boundary of the Ruined Heart.
Not to take his body back, that was impossible at that time, only to disrupt the command that was being sent from Black Silence to his muscles.
He had succeeded for a fraction of a second, the hand had stopped, the purple light in his eyes had shaken and then Black Silence had taken control again and slammed One into the tree.
Lian understood at that moment that he could still change something, very little but he could.
Then Seris attacked, the fight that he saw from inside his own body felt strange, but it was a short fight anyway, in fact it was not even a fight.
And when Black Silence wanted to finish Seris, Lian had interfered for the second time, this time more and for a little longer, enough for the body’s movement to stop.
Enough for Black Silence to notice something.
Not to understand that Lian was still alive, but it had felt the presence of some unknown resistance, at that moment the Young Vorhelm had pulled back.
Completely.
"If I do that one more time, it will understand that I’m still alive." he thought calmly in the darkness.

From that moment on, he had remained silent, just like a short time ago when the battle had started, he had seen and heard everything and when One had tried to reach him through their link again, he remained silent.
When Seris had said his name, he remained silent again.
When her voice had risen among the attacks and she had asked why Black Silence had chosen Lian’s body, he remained silent again.
Even when Seris had screamed—
"Help me, damn it!"
Lian had heard it, word by word, for a moment something inside him wanted to hit the wall of the heart again.
Just to show that he was there.
Just one pause, one finger movement, anything, but he had not done it, not because he could not, because he should not do it, everything would be ruined, his plan would fall apart.
Black Silence was not thinking about him right now, from the Calamity’s point of view, he was finished, he had been eaten, the body was empty and this was the greatest advantage Lian had.
And he was not willing to lose it just so Seris could feel better for a few seconds.
No matter how painful that scream was to hear, no matter how One had called him through their link, he had remained silent.
During all that time, he had not only watched but had also learned, not the exact thoughts of Black Silence, that creature did not have a mind that worked like a human mind.
But because it was using Lian’s body, some things passed through.
Hunger.
Purpose.
When the first chain broke and the Calamity became more complete and the pressure of that dark ocean became stronger and that was when he reached his conclusion.
Black Silence was incomplete, part of it was inside his body and part of it remained inside the Titan and as long as the two were separated, anything Lian did would remain incomplete.
Even if he somehow took his body back, he would only have part of the Calamity inside himself.
The other part could remain inside the Titan, be transferred again, find another host and return again.
If he was going to devour this creature, limit it or do anything else to it, all of it had to be in one place.
So Lian had done something that looked crazy from the outside.
He had simply done nothing...
He had allowed the first chain to break.
The second.
The third.
Even when he realized that the Titan was getting close to full awakening, he remained silent, because for once Black Silence’s goal was the same as his.
Completion.
Now there was no large part left inside the Titan.
Cindar was dead, the last anchor had been cut, the seals were broken and all of Black Silence was inside Lian’s body, in one place.
Exactly what he wanted and now the only thing left was to find a way to devour it.

Of course, one problem still remained, he had no certain way to devour it, devouring a skill and talent was one thing, devouring a complete creature, especially a Calamity that had infected a world for centuries was something else.
His Glutton ability had never been made to eat the creatures themselves and Lian knew this.
So his plan could not simply be to "eat" Black Silence.
But something else was also bothering him.
The system had said from the beginning to devour the Calamity itself, so if such a Quest existed, there had to be a way.
But Lian did not know any way right now and this was the annoying part.
His entire plan was based on a theory that he had no way to test beforehand.
But he knew one thing, he had no way to directly eat the Calamity itself, but perhaps he did not need to eat the Calamity in the same way it was.
In fact, maybe he could take a shortcut and not need to devour it directly himself, like using the Devourer Egg for help.
Maybe then a way would open.
Maybe.
The word "maybe" appeared too many times in this plan.
If Lian had a body, he would probably frown.
"Sounds very reliable." he said sarcastically in his mind.
There was no one to answer him, but even if that plan failed, he had another option.
The Ruined Heart.
This thing had been able to keep his identity out of the Calamity’s reach, so perhaps it could work the other way too.
If Lian took control of the body back for long enough, perhaps he could pull part of Black Silence into this closed space.
Or all of it.
He did not know how long he could hold it, one hour? One day? One month?
Maybe only a few minutes.
But even a few minutes were better than having a creature free that wanted to go to the earth and then eat other worlds.
"Worst case, I’ll make a prison for it." he thought with cold calmness.
"I’ll figure out how to devour it later."
The real problem was something else, how to take his body back.
When Black Silence had just come out of the cocoon, its connection to the body was still incomplete, that was when Lian had been able to interfere twice.
Now? The situation was completely different, the Calamity had become complete and all its parts had returned.
Its existence was wrapped around Lian’s body like countless roots..
And if he tried to forcefully take control right now, Black Silence would probably notice him before he could even move a finger.
And this time it would not settle for just a short search.
The Ruined Heart might hide his identity, but Lian was not willing to test whether it could resist the full attack of a complete Calamity or not.
He needed to create a moment when Black Silence’s control over the body would break.
Even for a fraction of a second.
What could do that? Lian had thought about the answer for a long time and in the end he had found only one option.
Death.
The body had to die.
The thought was simple, it was stupid too but it was simple, Black Silence was no longer a guest inside his body, it had merged with it and it had even proudly said a few minutes ago
"This body is mine."
Well, having a physical body was not only an advantage, it also had many disadvantages...

Every time they got close to the boundary, the space between them collapsed, as if the path itself was being destroyed, part of the darkness moved toward the heart and suddenly there was no longer a "way" to reach it.
A few moments later, the space around it formed again, Black Silence tried again, it failed again but apparently it did not even realize that something was there.
That was the strangest part.
The Ruined Heart had not only protected Lian, it had hidden him.
He looked at the broken heart for some time.
"What exactly are you?" he asked in his mind, even though he did not expect any answer.
There was no answer, of course and only the weak light inside the cracks of the heart pulsed once.
His gaze fell on the five indentations, exactly as if something was supposed to be placed there to fill them.
But what?...Calamities?
In any case, after being saved, it did not take long for Lian to be able to see the outside.
The first clear image was Seris, when they were still beside the Forgotten Tree and the Calamity had just come out of the cocoon.
She was lying injured on the ground, then One, who was crawling toward her body.
Then Black Silence raised his hand and he understood what he wanted to do.
A strike.
And that was the first time Lian had resisted, he had pushed everything that remained of himself against the boundary of the Ruined Heart.
Not to take his body back, that was impossible at that time, only to disrupt the command that was being sent from Black Silence to his muscles.
He had succeeded for a fraction of a second, the hand had stopped, the purple light in his eyes had shaken and then Black Silence had taken control again and slammed One into the tree.
Lian understood at that moment that he could still change something, very little but he could.
Then Seris attacked, the fight that he saw from inside his own body felt strange, but it was a short fight anyway, in fact it was not even a fight.
And when Black Silence wanted to finish Seris, Lian had interfered for the second time, this time more and for a little longer, enough for the body’s movement to stop.
Enough for Black Silence to notice something.
Not to understand that Lian was still alive, but it had felt the presence of some unknown resistance, at that moment the Young Vorhelm had pulled back.
Completely.
"If I do that one more time, it will understand that I’m still alive." he thought calmly in the darkness.

From that moment on, he had remained silent, just like a short time ago when the battle had started, he had seen and heard everything and when One had tried to reach him through their link again, he remained silent.
When Seris had said his name, he remained silent again.
When her voice had risen among the attacks and she had asked why Black Silence had chosen Lian’s body, he remained silent again.
Even when Seris had screamed—
"Help me, damn it!"
Lian had heard it, word by word, for a moment something inside him wanted to hit the wall of the heart again.
Just to show that he was there.
Just one pause, one finger movement, anything, but he had not done it, not because he could not, because he should not do it, everything would be ruined, his plan would fall apart.
Black Silence was not thinking about him right now, from the Calamity’s point of view, he was finished, he had been eaten, the body was empty and this was the greatest advantage Lian had.
And he was not willing to lose it just so Seris could feel better for a few seconds.
No matter how painful that scream was to hear, no matter how One had called him through their link, he had remained silent.
During all that time, he had not only watched but had also learned, not the exact thoughts of Black Silence, that creature did not have a mind that worked like a human mind.
But because it was using Lian’s body, some things passed through.
Hunger.
Purpose.
When the first chain broke and the Calamity became more complete and the pressure of that dark ocean became stronger and that was when he reached his conclusion.
Black Silence was incomplete, part of it was inside his body and part of it remained inside the Titan and as long as the two were separated, anything Lian did would remain incomplete.
Even if he somehow took his body back, he would only have part of the Calamity inside himself.
The other part could remain inside the Titan, be transferred again, find another host and return again.
If he was going to devour this creature, limit it or do anything else to it, all of it had to be in one place.
So Lian had done something that looked crazy from the outside.
He had simply done nothing...
He had allowed the first chain to break.
The second.
The third.
Even when he realized that the Titan was getting close to full awakening, he remained silent, because for once Black Silence’s goal was the same as his.
Completion.
Now there was no large part left inside the Titan.
Cindar was dead, the last anchor had been cut, the seals were broken and all of Black Silence was inside Lian’s body, in one place.
Exactly what he wanted and now the only thing left was to find a way to devour it.

Of course, one problem still remained, he had no certain way to devour it, devouring a skill and talent was one thing, devouring a complete creature, especially a Calamity that had infected a world for centuries was something else.
His Glutton ability had never been made to eat the creatures themselves and Lian knew this.
So his plan could not simply be to "eat" Black Silence.
But something else was also bothering him.
The system had said from the beginning to devour the Calamity itself, so if such a Quest existed, there had to be a way.
But Lian did not know any way right now and this was the annoying part.
His entire plan was based on a theory that he had no way to test beforehand.
But he knew one thing, he had no way to directly eat the Calamity itself, but perhaps he did not need to eat the Calamity in the same way it was.
In fact, maybe he could take a shortcut and not need to devour it directly himself, like using the Devourer Egg for help.
Maybe then a way would open.
Maybe.
The word "maybe" appeared too many times in this plan.
If Lian had a body, he would probably frown.
"Sounds very reliable." he said sarcastically in his mind.
There was no one to answer him, but even if that plan failed, he had another option.
The Ruined Heart.
This thing had been able to keep his identity out of the Calamity’s reach, so perhaps it could work the other way too.
If Lian took control of the body back for long enough, perhaps he could pull part of Black Silence into this closed space.
Or all of it.
He did not know how long he could hold it, one hour?
One day?
One month?
Maybe only a few minutes.
But even a few minutes were better than having a creature free that wanted to go to the earth and then eat other worlds.
"Worst case, I’ll make a prison for it." he thought with cold calmness.
"I’ll figure out how to devour it later."
The real problem was something else, how to take his body back.
When Black Silence had just come out of the cocoon, its connection to the body was still incomplete, that was when Lian had been able to interfere twice.
Now?
The situation was completely different, the Calamity had become complete and all its parts had returned.
Its existence was wrapped around Lian’s body like countless roots..
And if he tried to forcefully take control right now, Black Silence would probably notice him before he could even move a finger.
And this time it would not settle for just a short search.
The Ruined Heart might hide his identity, but Lian was not willing to test whether it could resist the full attack of a complete Calamity or not.
He needed to create a moment when Black Silence’s control over the body would break.
Even for a fraction of a second.
What could do that?
Lian had thought about the answer for a long time and in the end he had found only one option.
Death.
The body had to die.
The thought was simple, it was stupid too but it was simple, Black Silence was no longer a guest inside his body, it had merged with it and it had even proudly said a few minutes ago
"This body is mine."
Well, having a physical body was not only an advantage, it also had many disadvantages...

chapters.title: Chapter 384: Help Me Kill Myself
paragraphs: If the body is yours, then its death should belong to you too.
If the heart stopped, the brain stopped working, the mana channels collapsed and the spiritual connection was disrupted for a moment, Black Silence should also be affected.
Of course, not necessarily in a deadly way, it was probably not even close to being deadly, it was unlikely that the creature would be completely destroyed just by destroying its host.
At best, considering that both the anchor was dead and the vessel was destroyed, Black Silence would be completely expelled from the world.
But he could not let the Calamity be completely expelled, he needed to either devour it or at least find a way to temporarily imprison it for now.
He himself was not worried about dying, after all, he had an extra life, he just did not know how its mechanism worked.
If he died and came back to life again, would the Calamity still be controlling the body or not?
And there was another question, who should kill him?
The image outside became clearer in his mind.
The dust of the graveyard, the corpse of the Titan and the huge, changing shadow of Black Silence.
The four undead.
And Seris, she was still standing, her body had been badly injured in several places and there was a lot of pressure on her.
Her armor was covered in blood and dirt and she had also lost her sword, and her eyes were fixed on Black Silence’s body, something in her gaze had changed.
Lian could not see the panel that the system had shown Seris.
But he had seen the change in her behavior, after Cindar’s death, the Young Pendragon had completely stopped for a few seconds, looking at something in front of her.
Then her eyes had turned directly toward the Calamity, colder and heavier and now the intent in her eyes no longer looked like someone who only wanted to "save him".
Lian quickly reached a conclusion, the system had told her something and whatever it was, it seemed to have made the girl determined to kill him.
If that was the case, things were better than he had expected.
"Good." he thought with very slight satisfaction.

If there was someone there who was truly capable of putting her sword through Lian’s body, it was Seris and more importantly, if she came to the conclusion that there was no other way, she would probably really do it.
She could and that was exactly what Lian needed, just not yet.
If she killed his body right now, Black Silence was still freely focusing all its attention on the outside, death might break its connection.
It might separate from the body at that moment, forcefully take another creature, after all, it had the ability to do that, escape somewhere else or even simply be expelled from this world safely.
No.
First, he had to force Black Silence to lock its entire existence inside this body, he had to make sure that there was no way for it to escape at the moment of death.
He had to keep it busy here, then Seris would destroy the body and at the same time he would make his final move to imprison or devour the Calamity.
Lian looked at Seris again, for a few seconds he only observed her.
Her power, her speed, the way she stood, there was one small problem too, this girl did not have enough power to kill his body.
"This is a little troublesome." He sighed and thought about how he could help.
The Young Pendragon was also not strong enough in her current condition, she had once been able to force Black Silence to defend itself with Swordheart Override.
Now that power increase was over and her body was injured, if she attacked directly again, the Calamity would probably kill her.

Besides, Black Silence was no longer busy destroying the chains and could kill all the Awakened who were there and another problem was that there were only about seven minutes left before the Calamity was expelled from the world.
Lian needed to change the situation, only a little, not enough for Black Silence to notice his interference.

Just enough to make one of Seris’s attacks more dangerous than it should be, for example, making one of its body movements slightly slower or making one defense happen a fraction of a second later and maybe that would be enough.
But could he do it? He focused his attention on the Ruined Heart, maybe this thing could help him.
Its broken surface was slowly pulsing, with every pulse, a weak light moved through its cracks, he still did not know how to control it.
In fact, until only a few minutes ago, he was not even sure this thing was anything more than a shelter.
But now he tried to connect with it directly.
"Just give me back control of my body once." Lian continued with more focus.
Suddenly, the light inside one of the cracks became slightly stronger and he stopped and a panel appeared in front of his vision.
[The Ruined Heart has reacted.]
[Interference with the host’s control is possible.]
[Available time: 1.5 seconds.]
If he had a body, he would probably have raised an eyebrow.
One and a half seconds.
That was all the Ruined Heart could buy him against a complete Calamity.
It was little, in fact it was so little that it almost felt like a joke, what the hell was he supposed to do with this amount of time?
One and a half seconds was not enough to talk, not enough for a fight and for taking his body back? Ridiculous.
But it was enough to ruin a movement, enough to change the angle of a hand and enough to leave a vital point open and enough to let a sword enter his heart...
Lian looked at the image outside, Seris was still standing there, her teeth pressed together.
Anger.
Tiredness.
Hesitation.
He could see all of them in that one eye, but she still had not attacked.
"That girl really does not know when to give up." Lian thought with familiar sarcasm.
Then he went silent, good, this was exactly what he needed, Black Silence thought he was dead and Seris thought she might have to kill him.
And the Ruined Heart had given him one and a half seconds, now he only had to put everything in the right place.
First, he had to test his theory, then he had to make Black Silence completely engage in a fight.
Then he had to die.
And if everything went right, that death would become his real chance to take his body back.
If he was wrong? He thought about that possibility for some time.
The answer was simple, it would not matter anymore, because at that point he would truly be destroyed.
His attention returned to Seris, the girl took a normal sword out of her storage space and at the same time Lian slowly moved his entire existence closer to the boundary of the Ruined Heart.
This time he did not intend to interfere too early.
First, he had to make Black Silence truly be forced to fight Seris, then he would spend his one and a half seconds.
And maybe that one and a half seconds would be enough to end everything.
"Good."
"Then I just have to help her kill me."

chapters.title: Chapter 385: No More Suppression
paragraphs: Seris put her blood-covered hand into her storage space and pulled out the first sword she found.
The weapon was not even comparable to her main sword.

It had a simple gray blade, its balance was average, and she could not feel any special effect inside it, but in the current situation, even this piece of metal was better than fighting with bare hands.
She gripped the handle tightly and kept her eyes fixed on Lian’s body.

Behind that human body, the shadow of Black Silence was still changing shape. One moment, something like endless wings could be seen, and the next moment, thousands of dark mouths that seemed to have opened from different points in space.
But before she could take a step, the four remaining lines of light across the cemetery shook at the same time.
Seraphina immediately raised her head, and the color drained from her face.
[The final command has ended.]
[Suppression of the undead has been canceled.]
[Recovered power: 100%]
The four lines of light disappeared, and then the pressure changed, the entire battlefield became heavier in an instant.
The Cindari swordsman slowly raised his head, the Root Controller placed his foot on the ground, the Cindari mage gathered the gray mana around his body, and the pale Cindari clenched his fists.
And now everyone understood how important that thirty percent suppression had been.
Rindo did not even have time to give a new command, the swordsman moved, and the Awakened who was standing a few meters ahead only felt a cold wind around his neck.
Then his head was separated from his body.
Only one step and one sword movement were enough, and the headless body fell to the ground.
Rindo froze for a moment, and at that moment he understood a very simple truth, they were no longer going to hold this battle back.
They were only delaying the time of their own deaths.
But before he could say anything, the system opened another panel in front of everyone’s eyes.
[Warning.]
[The complete presence of the Calamity is incompatible with the structure of this world.]
[Time remaining until expulsion: 06:59]
One of the Awakened saw the number and let out a shocked breath, and for a moment pure hope appeared on his face.
"Only seven minutes! We just have to stay alive!" he shouted loudly and almost smiled.
"Are you stupid?" Seris answered coldly without taking her eyes off Black Silence.
The man’s smile disappeared.
Rindo only looked at the panel for a moment and very quickly understood the meaning of Seris’s words.
"Being expelled does not mean being destroyed." He said with a dark expression and raised his sword again, the expressions of not only him but all the members of their group became ugly.
If this world could not keep Black Silence inside itself, the Calamity would only be thrown out of this world.
It would not be killed or destroyed, it would only be expelled, and Black Silence itself clearly knew this.
Very thin white cracks had appeared around Lian’s body.
The space around him sometimes shook, and part of the huge shadow behind him sank into those cracks and came back out.
But there was no worry on his face, not even a little, because this was exactly what he had been waiting for.
This world was no longer worth staying in, the Primordial Root had been destroyed hundreds of years ago, and its remains, the Forgotten Tree, was now dead.
The Titan had also fallen to the ground and its huge body was already decaying, the remaining civilizations of this world were also falling apart by their own hands right now.
And these civilizations were also far too weak and worthless, at first he planned to completely destroy this world, but he felt there was no need to waste time.
If Black Silence wanted, it could still find another anchor in this world.

It did not even need to look far, the four undead who were still fighting for it were ready to offer their bodies, souls, and existence to one of the children of the "Father" without the slightest hesitation.
But why should it stay here? In the memories of the body that it now considered its own, it had seen another world.
Earth.
A world with billions of living beings, huge cities, civilizations that covered the entire world, and an unbelievable amount of energy.
And more importantly, billions of lives that contained fear, hatred, greed, jealousy, attachment, love, and anger.
Weaknesses that could slowly be taken, twisted, and turned into weapons.
For Black Silence, Earth was not just another world, it was a feast that had not even been touched yet.
And to reach it, it only had to wait less than seven more minutes.
Of course, it would be better to get rid of the annoying people before leaving.
The Cindari swordsman moved again, and the three remaining Cindari from Taverne’s forces attacked him almost at the same time.
The first brought his sword down from above, the second attacked from the side, and the third sent his long spear straight toward the target’s heart.
The swordsman only took one step and his blade moved from bottom to top, the first Cindari was cut in half at the waist and did not even have time to scream.
The next turn separated the second man’s right arm along with his sword, the man opened his mouth to scream, but the next strike passed through his throat and the sound was drowned in blood.

The third immediately stepped back, his instinct told him to run, but it was too late and the swordsman did not even move toward him, he only turned his blade slightly and a thin line appeared in the air.
A moment later, the Cindari’s chest opened from shoulder to stomach and his body fell to the ground.
Tavern looked at the scene with wide eyes full of anger, now he understood how big a difference that thirty percent suppression had made.
And it had given them the false hope that maybe they could stand against them.
"Fall back—" Tavern opened his mouth, but the swordsman moved again, one of his last soldiers, exactly the Cindari woman who was always beside him, was directly in his path.
When he saw this, he could not take it and threw himself forward without thinking, the blade entered his side and the sound of flesh being cut disappeared among the sounds of the battlefield.
Tavern’s eyes opened wider for a moment, blood came out of his mouth, but instead of stepping back, he grabbed the blade with both hands.
The sword was halfway inside his body, but he did not let the swordsman pull it out.
"Now!" he shouted with a low voice covered in blood.
Cassian and one of the nearby Awakened attacked at the same moment.
Two attacks hit the swordsman’s shoulder and chest at the same time, and the creature was pushed several meters back, but only several meters.
Tavern was still standing, or at least his body had not fallen yet.
The swordsman pulled the blade out of his side with a rough movement and blood burst out.
He could not hold on anymore and fell onto one knee.
The swordsman made a second strike, this time the blade passed from the top of his chest to the bottom of his stomach, the armor split, the flesh opened, and Tavern lost his breath.
His eyes looked into the distance for a moment.
At the dead Titan.
At the bodies of the Cindari he had brought with him.
At the world he had come to save.
But he did not look at Cindar’s corpse even once, the Founder was no longer worth even his final thought.
In the end, his body fell to the ground and did not move again.
"Tavern!" The woman, the only remaining Cindari, shouted angrily and attacked.
Three seconds later, her head was on the ground and none of the Cindari who had left Vhalaris with Tavern were alive anymore.
They had come to save their race, and in the end, they all died in the cemetery that their Founder had created hundreds of years ago.
The ground exploded in another part of the battlefield, and dozens of huge roots came out from under the ground.

Aren slammed his right foot onto the ground, a wave of mana entered the earth from the bottom of his foot, and the ground in front of him moved like water for a moment, changing the path of several roots.
But not all of them, one of the roots passed through the stomach of an Awakened, and the man stared with wide eyes at the wooden object coming out of his body.
The root lifted him several meters into the air, then suddenly moved to the side and the corpse fell onto the rocks.
Another root came out from under the feet of the second Awakened and grabbed his body from the side, two more roots wrapped around him from two directions.
The sound of bones breaking was loud and the man did not even have time to scream.
Aren clenched his teeth.
"Left side!" he warned with all his strength and slammed his foot onto the ground again.
Liana threw herself to the right without thinking, a thick root came out from the place where she had been standing a moment before.
But the Awakened behind her reacted too late, the wood went straight into his chest and its bloody tip came out from the back of his body.
Warm blood splashed across the girl’s face, she froze for a moment, only for a moment, and then the man’s body passed beside her and fell to the ground.
Liana wiped her face with the back of her hand, but the blood did not come off and only spread more.
Her eyes moved around for a moment.
A corpse.
A root.
Blood.
The people who had been standing beside them only a few minutes ago were dying one by one.
The battle that had been under their control only a few minutes ago... had now become a slaughterhouse for them and they were being killed one by one...
Not to mention the world itself, whether they could even save themselves was also a question.
"Damn..." she whispered with a shaking voice and stared at her Shadow wolf.
But at that moment, roots came out of the ground and targeted the Shadow wolf, a root came out through the wolf and created a large hole in its stomach.
"Nooooo!" All of Liana’s rational control broke apart when she saw that scene and she rushed toward her summon to hug it and save it.
"Focus!" Aren shouted angrily and raised a wall of earth in front of the girl with his foot.
Three roots crashed into the wall and the stone cracked.
He took a heavy breath, his mana was almost gone and it was unlikely that he could continue fighting for much longer, but he still did not step back.
A massacre had begun.

The Cindari swordsman slowly raised his head, the Root Controller placed his foot on the ground, the Cindari mage gathered the gray mana around his body, and the pale Cindari clenched his fists.
And now everyone understood how important that thirty percent suppression had been.
Rindo did not even have time to give a new command, the swordsman moved, and the Awakened who was standing a few meters ahead only felt a cold wind around his neck.
Then his head was separated from his body.
Only one step and one sword movement were enough, and the headless body fell to the ground.
Rindo froze for a moment, and at that moment he understood a very simple truth, they were no longer going to hold this battle back.
They were only delaying the time of their own deaths.
But before he could say anything, the system opened another panel in front of everyone’s eyes.
[Warning.]
[The complete presence of the Calamity is incompatible with the structure of this world.]
[Time remaining until expulsion: 06:59]
One of the Awakened saw the number and let out a shocked breath, and for a moment pure hope appeared on his face.
"Only seven minutes!
We just have to stay alive!" he shouted loudly and almost smiled.
"Are you stupid?" Seris answered coldly without taking her eyes off Black Silence.
The man’s smile disappeared.
Rindo only looked at the panel for a moment and very quickly understood the meaning of Seris’s words.
"Being expelled does not mean being destroyed." He said with a dark expression and raised his sword again, the expressions of not only him but all the members of their group became ugly.
If this world could not keep Black Silence inside itself, the Calamity would only be thrown out of this world.
It would not be killed or destroyed, it would only be expelled, and Black Silence itself clearly knew this.
Very thin white cracks had appeared around Lian’s body.
The space around him sometimes shook, and part of the huge shadow behind him sank into those cracks and came back out.
But there was no worry on his face, not even a little, because this was exactly what he had been waiting for.
This world was no longer worth staying in, the Primordial Root had been destroyed hundreds of years ago, and its remains, the Forgotten Tree, was now dead.
The Titan had also fallen to the ground and its huge body was already decaying, the remaining civilizations of this world were also falling apart by their own hands right now.
And these civilizations were also far too weak and worthless, at first he planned to completely destroy this world, but he felt there was no need to waste time.
If Black Silence wanted, it could still find another anchor in this world.

It did not even need to look far, the four undead who were still fighting for it were ready to offer their bodies, souls, and existence to one of the children of the "Father" without the slightest hesitation.
But why should it stay here?
In the memories of the body that it now considered its own, it had seen another world.
Earth.
A world with billions of living beings, huge cities, civilizations that covered the entire world, and an unbelievable amount of energy.
And more importantly, billions of lives that contained fear, hatred, greed, jealousy, attachment, love, and anger.
Weaknesses that could slowly be taken, twisted, and turned into weapons.
For Black Silence, Earth was not just another world, it was a feast that had not even been touched yet.
And to reach it, it only had to wait less than seven more minutes.
Of course, it would be better to get rid of the annoying people before leaving.
The Cindari swordsman moved again, and the three remaining Cindari from Taverne’s forces attacked him almost at the same time.
The first brought his sword down from above, the second attacked from the side, and the third sent his long spear straight toward the target’s heart.
The swordsman only took one step and his blade moved from bottom to top, the first Cindari was cut in half at the waist and did not even have time to scream.
The next turn separated the second man’s right arm along with his sword, the man opened his mouth to scream, but the next strike passed through his throat and the sound was drowned in blood.

The third immediately stepped back, his instinct told him to run, but it was too late and the swordsman did not even move toward him, he only turned his blade slightly and a thin line appeared in the air.
A moment later, the Cindari’s chest opened from shoulder to stomach and his body fell to the ground.
Tavern looked at the scene with wide eyes full of anger, now he understood how big a difference that thirty percent suppression had made.
And it had given them the false hope that maybe they could stand against them.
"Fall back—" Tavern opened his mouth, but the swordsman moved again, one of his last soldiers, exactly the Cindari woman who was always beside him, was directly in his path.
When he saw this, he could not take it and threw himself forward without thinking, the blade entered his side and the sound of flesh being cut disappeared among the sounds of the battlefield.
Tavern’s eyes opened wider for a moment, blood came out of his mouth, but instead of stepping back, he grabbed the blade with both hands.
The sword was halfway inside his body, but he did not let the swordsman pull it out.
"Now!" he shouted with a low voice covered in blood.
Cassian and one of the nearby Awakened attacked at the same moment.
Two attacks hit the swordsman’s shoulder and chest at the same time, and the creature was pushed several meters back, but only several meters.
Tavern was still standing, or at least his body had not fallen yet.
The swordsman pulled the blade out of his side with a rough movement and blood burst out.
He could not hold on anymore and fell onto one knee.
The swordsman made a second strike, this time the blade passed from the top of his chest to the bottom of his stomach, the armor split, the flesh opened, and Tavern lost his breath.
His eyes looked into the distance for a moment.
At the dead Titan.
At the bodies of the Cindari he had brought with him.
At the world he had come to save.
But he did not look at Cindar’s corpse even once, the Founder was no longer worth even his final thought.
In the end, his body fell to the ground and did not move again.
"Tavern!" The woman, the only remaining Cindari, shouted angrily and attacked.
Three seconds later, her head was on the ground and none of the Cindari who had left Vhalaris with Tavern were alive anymore.
They had come to save their race, and in the end, they all died in the cemetery that their Founder had created hundreds of years ago.
The ground exploded in another part of the battlefield, and dozens of huge roots came out from under the ground.

Aren slammed his right foot onto the ground, a wave of mana entered the earth from the bottom of his foot, and the ground in front of him moved like water for a moment, changing the path of several roots.
But not all of them, one of the roots passed through the stomach of an Awakened, and the man stared with wide eyes at the wooden object coming out of his body.
The root lifted him several meters into the air, then suddenly moved to the side and the corpse fell onto the rocks.
Another root came out from under the feet of the second Awakened and grabbed his body from the side, two more roots wrapped around him from two directions.
The sound of bones breaking was loud and the man did not even have time to scream.
Aren clenched his teeth.
"Left side!" he warned with all his strength and slammed his foot onto the ground again.
Liana threw herself to the right without thinking, a thick root came out from the place where she had been standing a moment before.
But the Awakened behind her reacted too late, the wood went straight into his chest and its bloody tip came out from the back of his body.
Warm blood splashed across the girl’s face, she froze for a moment, only for a moment, and then the man’s body passed beside her and fell to the ground.
Liana wiped her face with the back of her hand, but the blood did not come off and only spread more.
Her eyes moved around for a moment.
A corpse.
A root.
Blood.
The people who had been standing beside them only a few minutes ago were dying one by one.
The battle that had been under their control only a few minutes ago... had now become a slaughterhouse for them and they were being killed one by one...
Not to mention the world itself, whether they could even save themselves was also a question.
"Damn..." she whispered with a shaking voice and stared at her Shadow wolf.
But at that moment, roots came out of the ground and targeted the Shadow wolf, a root came out through the wolf and created a large hole in its stomach.
"Nooooo!" All of Liana’s rational control broke apart when she saw that scene and she rushed toward her summon to hug it and save it.
"Focus!" Aren shouted angrily and raised a wall of earth in front of the girl with his foot.
Three roots crashed into the wall and the stone cracked.
He took a heavy breath, his mana was almost gone and it was unlikely that he could continue fighting for much longer, but he still did not step back.
A massacre had begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 386: The Call from Vhalaris
paragraphs: In another part, Selina spread both of her hands.
A huge wave of water formed in front of her and rushed toward the Ash Mage with great force.
But this time, the mage did not even step back, ash poured out from its body, and the water turned dark the moment they touched.
The sound of boiling rose and burning steam covered the entire area, the girl raised her arms in front of her face, and the skin on her hands immediately turned red.
Seraphina came out of the steam, her sword covered in condensed mana.
Her body was still shaking from the long use of the Chain Command, but she no longer stayed back, if they wanted to fight, she also had to help.
She sent the blade directly toward the mage’s neck and the mage raised its hand.
A layer of condensed ash formed and Seraphina’s sword went halfway into it.
"Selina!" she shouted and put all her weight on the blade.
Selina immediately clenched her hand, a wave of water rose from behind the Ash Mage and for a moment, the creature’s entire body was trapped between the water and the sword.
But then an explosion of ash happened.
BOOOOOM!
Both girls were thrown backward and Seraphina rolled across the ground, while Selina hit a rock.
One of the four Awakened that Darian had brought from Crystal-Line used the chance and came from behind.
He raised his sword and was only one step away from the mage.
The mage did not even turn around, its fingers opened and a mass of ash entered the Awakened’s mouth and nose like fog.
The man stopped right there, his eyes opened wider and he grabbed his throat, then black smoke came out from the corners of his eyes.
From his mouth.
From his nose.
His knees bent and a few moments later he fell lifeless to the ground.
"Get up." Seraphina said to Selina while she herself was also having a hard time getting up.
"I am trying." Selina coughed and answered with a broken voice and gathered water around herself again.
Neither of them was thinking about victory and only about staying alive.
In the center of the battlefield, the Cindari that had the biggest body among all of them attacked Rindo’s formation directly.
A heavily armored Awakened raised his shield and that Cindari’s fist came down.
Clang!
The shield sank in and the bones in the man’s hand broke, and the force of the same attack was transferred to his chest.
The sound of several bones breaking one after another could be heard and the man fell to the ground with his shield.
Rindo attacked from the left, Cassian from the right and both blades hit the guardian at the same time.
Wounds appeared but the creature did not even stop and reached out his hand and grabbed another Awakened by the neck.
The man tried to open its fingers with both hands but it was useless, the undead lifted him like a light object and then slammed him into the ground.
Once.
Twice.
The second time, his skull broke.
"Cassian, right!" Rindo clenched his teeth and shouted and made another attack himself.
Cassian immediately changed his position, for a few seconds they were able to keep that creature back.
Only a few seconds.
But at that moment, the communication crystal on Rindo’s back began to shake.
Once.
Rindo ignored it.
The second time, he ignored it again.
The third time, it was so strong that its light could be seen through his clothes.
"Damn it!" he said angrily and while placing his weapon in front of the guardian’s fist, he activated the crystal.
The sound of shouting and explosions immediately came out from it.
"Rindo! Can you hear me?!" Marcus was almost shouting from the other side of the communication.
"Speak!" Rindo answered with a tight jaw while covering Cassian.
"Vhalaris is out of control!" Marcus shouted without any introduction.
The sound of metal hitting came from behind him, followed by someone’s scream and then the sound of something breaking.
"Humans are killing Cindari, Cindari are killing Humans!" Ed continued with a broken voice.
"The western section has fallen!"
"The second medical center is on fire!"
"We can no longer separate the infected!"
"Behind you!" Ethan’s voice was suddenly heard from far away as he shouted in fear.
Then BOOOOM!
The communication was filled with noise for several seconds and at the same time Rindo dodged the guardian’s attack and Cassian attacked from the side.
The crystal made a sound again.
"Rindo..." Marcus’s voice was more tired this time.
"This is no longer a city, it is a slaughterhouse."
The Student Council President looked around for a moment.
Human corpses, Cindari corpses, blood on the ground, four ancient undead, Black Silence and farther away, Seris still standing in front of Lian’s body.
"Stay alive as long as you can." Rindo said heavily, what else could he say? They themselves were barely alive.
"What about you?" Marcus asked.
Rindo looked at the huge Cindari that was coming toward him again and a bitter smile appeared on his face.
"We are trying too." he answered tiredly and ended the communication.
The massacre continued, the second Awakened who had come with Darian was killed by the Root Controller.
The third one was burned in the Ash Mage’s attack and the fourth tried to attack the huge Cindari from behind and his heart stopped right there from a direct punch to the chest.
The selected members of Ashfall also fell one by one.
One lost his head.
Another Awakened was crushed between the roots.
One was burned by the hot steam and before they could save him, the Cindari mage finished him.
A few minutes ago, dozens of people were fighting in the cemetery, now Rindo looked around for a moment, the number of people who were still alive could be counted on two hands.
Himself, Cassian, Liana, Selina, Seraphina, Aren, Darian, Seris and One, that was all.
But there was another problem, although they were alive, none of them were healthy and all of them were seriously injured.
Rindo could no longer move his left hand properly, the bone in his forearm was broken.
Cassian had almost lost his entire armor and serious wounds could be seen all over his body.
Liana had several deep cuts on her side and thigh that made it very hard for her to move and she had also lost her only living summon.
Selina was breathing heavily and her mana was very low.
After controlling the chains and fighting, Seraphina was so tired and had so little energy left that the hand holding her sword was shaking.
Aren had played a major role in protecting them with his earth elemental magic and because of that, his mana reserves were close to running out.
Darian was bleeding from his forehead and side.
Seris was in the worst condition of all and despite that, the four undead were still standing, and Black Silence was completely unharmed.
In this condition, if they could see the next two minutes, they would be considered very lucky.
[Time remaining until forced expulsion: 04:26]
Seris also saw the entire situation, she knew all their chances were gone, she knew they had nothing left and the bigger problem was that the Main Quest had also failed.
[Main Quest Failed]
[The Corrupted Titan has awakened and the Calamity has been completely completed and released.]
[Penalty: Black Silence’s entry into Earth is unavoidable.]
This was the notification that had appeared some time ago.
It was clear that even the system had lost its hope for them and saw the Calamity’s entry into their world as unstoppable.
But she had not lost her hope yet, they still had four minutes.
She took a step forward and raised her ordinary sword.
Black Silence focused all of its attention on her, that strange smile was no longer there, there was no curiosity either and only coldness could be felt from it.
Seris attacked and the Calamity moved at the same time and its fist came directly toward the girl’s neck to break it.
The Young Pendragon bent down at the last moment and the fist passed over her head but the force from the attack reached the rock behind her.
The rock broke in half.
Seris was still low when the second attack came toward her chest, she raised her sword horizontally.
Clang!
The blade immediately cracked and the force of the attack passed through the sword, her body was thrown dozens of meters backward.
She rolled across the ground and before she could fully stand up a shadow fell over her.
Black Silence was above her, its foot rose, she threw herself to the side with all her strength and the foot landed on the ground.
BOOOOM!
A deep crater formed.
Pieces of rock fell onto Seris’s body, she pulled herself up with one hand, she had not even fully stood up when the Calamity came toward her again.
This time there was no hesitation or pause in its attacks, it truly wanted to kill Seris and it wanted to do it quickly and now!
