chapters.title: Chapter 387: The Price of One Last Stand
paragraphs: The Young Pendragon raised her cracked sword, and the Calamity’s hand moved toward her face, this one seemed unavoidable!
But before the impact, a short roar came from the side.
One.
The giant ant attacked with all the speed it had left, its jaws opened, and it crashed directly into Lian’s side.
Black Silence did not even fully turn toward One and only moved his hand, throwing a simple punch, but at the same time Seris attacked from the other side.
Although the girl’s attack did not even reach its target, the force of Lian’s punch hit both of them.
BOOOOOOM!
One and Seris were thrown toward the rocks behind them together, the first rock broke ...then the second one, and dust covered everything.
The girl fell among the rocks, she heard several of her own bones breaking, pain spread through her side and back, she felt like her breath was stuck inside her lungs.
For several moments, she could not even breathe properly and vomited blood.
But when she raised her head, her eyes stopped on One, one of the ant’s legs was bent at a completely wrong angle.
A large part of its chest armor had been pushed inward, and one of its antennae was broken halfway.
One tried to stand up, its two front legs pressed against the ground, its body rose for a moment, but then it fell again.
A second attempt, and it fell to the ground again.
Seris clenched her jaw, this was not a scene that was easy for her to watch.
One’s emotions were weakly transmitted from far away through the Hive Link at that moment ... and the person who was supposed to feel those emotions, did.
Terrible pain ... pain that the ant would rather die than feel ... but beneath that pain, the same foolish and unchanging loyalty was still there.

And the person on the other side of the Hive Link who felt those transmitted emotions was only becoming colder and colder, she was silent, she still did not interfere, but only she knew how badly she wanted to destroy that Calamity at this moment.
And soon, she would get her chance, if she revealed herself now, everything she had been waiting for would be lost.
On the other side, Black Silence slowly walked out of the dust, his face was completely emotionless.
"It’s time to finish off the pests." he said with Lian’s voice but without the slightest emotion.
His hand rose, this time if the attack landed, Seris would die.
The girl was on one knee, her breathing was uneven and her normal sword was almost broken, several of her ribs were damaged and she could feel a burning pain from inside.
And One could no longer stand.
This really seemed like the end for them ... but maybe not.
There was no other choice, so Seris put her hand inside her storage space.
A small orb appeared in the palm of her hand, the surface of the orb was almost black, but under its dark shell, a red light like blood slowly moved.
The Young Pendragon only looked at it for a moment.
This was the medium that allowed Sovereign’s Last Stand to be activated in its strongest form.
She had used its stored energy once before, beside the Forgotten Tree.
It had been completely emptied.
But during the six-day journey back and then their journey toward the Giants’ Graveyard, every monster they had been forced to kill, Seris had given its corpse to the orb.
Dozens of corpses had all entered it.
But—
[Stored Energy: 11%]
[Minimum Energy Required for Activation: 75%]
The stored energy was low, very low, and the distance from the minimum she needed was also very large.
Black Silence was getting closer.
But monster corpses were not the only thing that could act as fuel for this artifact, in fact, there was another fuel as well.
But it was far too valuable, not only to her but to all Awakened.
[Holder’s Permanent Stats.]
Her eyes narrowed for a moment, this was no longer a monster corpse that could be found anywhere, it was not something that could simply return with rest or a potion.
Stats that she had worked hard to collect over the years with her resources and growth, and had fully maxed out.
If they were burned, they would be gone, she would have to collect her stats again from the beginning with the help of resources, treasures, and ... and this would put her far behind the others.
It could practically ruin her and keep her out of the ranking of the strongest S-Generation Awakened for a long time.
[1,000 Stat Points are required to complete the energy.]
[Warning.]
[Consumed points cannot be restored.]
[Confirm?]
Seris frowned even more after seeing the required amount, but Black Silence was only a few meters away.
One could not stand up, the battlefield was full of corpses, Vhalaris was collapsing, and if they lost in less than a few more minutes, Earth would be next.
"Yes." the Young Pendragon said with a blood-covered face and a cold gaze.
The panel changed.
[1,000 Stat Points consumed.]
At that moment, she felt as if something had been torn out of her existence, a power that truly belonged to her was disappearing.
[Strength: 520 ← 260]
[Resistance: 280 ← 140]
[Total Stats: 2000 ← 1000]
Half of her total raw power disappeared within a few seconds.
Her legs became weak for a moment, her body felt as if it had suddenly become heavier.
But the orb began to pulse, and the red light inside it became stronger.
[Energy: 75%]
[Activation conditions fulfilled.]
"Activate." Seris said calmly.
[Sovereign’s Last Stand]
The world turned red for a moment, and all of Seris’s pain disappeared and became meaningless, her bleeding was forcibly stopped.
Her torn muscles were forced to move with mana and life force, her damaged bones no longer had the right to stop her body.
Her heart beat so heavily that every beat felt like a hit from inside her chest.
The closer she was to death, the more power she received, and she was very close at that moment.
[Remaining Duration: 00:40]
[All delayed damage will be applied after the effect ends.]
[Chance of death after the effect ends: Very High.]
She looked at the last line, there was no fear on her face.
"Then I have to finish this before that.
But even this was not enough, Seris knew this, even when she had activated it beside the Forgotten Tree, she had not been able to perform a miracle and win.
She still needed to become stronger.
Moonless Severance at its current rank did not have enough power to cut through Lian’s body as much as needed.
So she opened another panel.
[Fragments Available: 102]
[Moonless Severance — Great Rank]
[Upgrade Available.]
[Cost: 61 Fragments]
"Do it." she ordered firmly.
[61 Fragments consumed.]
[Remaining Fragments: 41]
White and black light wrapped around her cracked sword.
[Moonless Severance evolved.]
[Absolute Moonless Severance]
[Rank: Great --> Divine]

[Damage increased by up to 125%]
[Deep Damage increased by up to 125%]
[Critical Hit Chance increased by 75%]
[Each attack consumes 25 Mana.]
[Warning: Mana consumption and mental pressure increase according to the difference in power.]
Seris’s eyes stayed on the description for a moment, it was enough, she only needed to make the cut deep enough, and now she could do it.
Darian had seen everything from far away.
The orb.
The sudden drop in Seris’s presence, then the explosion of new power and the strange light, he did not know exactly what she had burned, but he understood one thing completely.
This girl had no intention of retreating.
He also raised the Seven-Colored Heaven Bow, blood was running down from the side of his forehead.
His mana was also no longer in good condition, but he pulled the bowstring.
"I don’t know what you’re planning to do, but I’ve got your back." he said in a cold but serious voice and fixed his gaze on Black Silence.
Seris looked at him for a moment and said nothing.
Darian activated his skill.

Seven colored rings appeared behind the bow, one after another, and seven-colored light separated from the bow.

His face became a little pale, but his hand did not shake on the bowstring.
"Let’s see how truly invincible you are." he then said with a very cold smile.

sentences.text: The Young Pendragon raised her cracked sword, and the Calamity’s hand moved toward her face, this one seemed unavoidable!
But before the impact, a short roar came from the side.
One.
The giant ant attacked with all the speed it had left, its jaws opened, and it crashed directly into Lian’s side.
Black Silence did not even fully turn toward One and only moved his hand, throwing a simple punch, but at the same time Seris attacked from the other side.
Although the girl’s attack did not even reach its target, the force of Lian’s punch hit both of them.
BOOOOOOM!
One and Seris were thrown toward the rocks behind them together, the first rock broke ...then the second one, and dust covered everything.
The girl fell among the rocks, she heard several of her own bones breaking, pain spread through her side and back, she felt like her breath was stuck inside her lungs.
For several moments, she could not even breathe properly and vomited blood.
But when she raised her head, her eyes stopped on One, one of the ant’s legs was bent at a completely wrong angle.
A large part of its chest armor had been pushed inward, and one of its antennae was broken halfway.
One tried to stand up, its two front legs pressed against the ground, its body rose for a moment, but then it fell again.
A second attempt, and it fell to the ground again.
Seris clenched her jaw, this was not a scene that was easy for her to watch.
One’s emotions were weakly transmitted from far away through the Hive Link at that moment ... and the person who was supposed to feel those emotions, did.
Terrible pain ... pain that the ant would rather die than feel ... but beneath that pain, the same foolish and unchanging loyalty was still there.

And the person on the other side of the Hive Link who felt those transmitted emotions was only becoming colder and colder, she was silent, she still did not interfere, but only she knew how badly she wanted to destroy that Calamity at this moment.
And soon, she would get her chance, if she revealed herself now, everything she had been waiting for would be lost.
On the other side, Black Silence slowly walked out of the dust, his face was completely emotionless.
"It’s time to finish off the pests." he said with Lian’s voice but without the slightest emotion.
His hand rose, this time if the attack landed, Seris would die.
The girl was on one knee, her breathing was uneven and her normal sword was almost broken, several of her ribs were damaged and she could feel a burning pain from inside.
And One could no longer stand.
This really seemed like the end for them ... but maybe not.
There was no other choice, so Seris put her hand inside her storage space.
A small orb appeared in the palm of her hand, the surface of the orb was almost black, but under its dark shell, a red light like blood slowly moved.
The Young Pendragon only looked at it for a moment.
This was the medium that allowed Sovereign’s Last Stand to be activated in its strongest form.
She had used its stored energy once before, beside the Forgotten Tree.
It had been completely emptied.
But during the six-day journey back and then their journey toward the Giants’ Graveyard, every monster they had been forced to kill, Seris had given its corpse to the orb.
Dozens of corpses had all entered it.
But—
[Stored Energy: 11%]
[Minimum Energy Required for Activation: 75%]
The stored energy was low, very low, and the distance from the minimum she needed was also very large.
Black Silence was getting closer.
But monster corpses were not the only thing that could act as fuel for this artifact, in fact, there was another fuel as well.
But it was far too valuable, not only to her but to all Awakened.
[Holder’s Permanent Stats.]
Her eyes narrowed for a moment, this was no longer a monster corpse that could be found anywhere, it was not something that could simply return with rest or a potion.
Stats that she had worked hard to collect over the years with her resources and growth, and had fully maxed out.
If they were burned, they would be gone, she would have to collect her stats again from the beginning with the help of resources, treasures, and ... and this would put her far behind the others.
It could practically ruin her and keep her out of the ranking of the strongest S-Generation Awakened for a long time.
[1,000 Stat Points are required to complete the energy.]
[Warning.]
[Consumed points cannot be restored.]
[Confirm?]
Seris frowned even more after seeing the required amount, but Black Silence was only a few meters away.
One could not stand up, the battlefield was full of corpses, Vhalaris was collapsing, and if they lost in less than a few more minutes, Earth would be next.
"Yes." the Young Pendragon said with a blood-covered face and a cold gaze.
The panel changed.
[1,000 Stat Points consumed.]
At that moment, she felt as if something had been torn out of her existence, a power that truly belonged to her was disappearing.
[Strength: 520 ← 260]
[Resistance: 280 ← 140]
[Total Stats: 2000 ← 1000]
Half of her total raw power disappeared within a few seconds.
Her legs became weak for a moment, her body felt as if it had suddenly become heavier.
But the orb began to pulse, and the red light inside it became stronger.
[Energy: 75%]
[Activation conditions fulfilled.]
"Activate." Seris said calmly.
[Sovereign’s Last Stand]
The world turned red for a moment, and all of Seris’s pain disappeared and became meaningless, her bleeding was forcibly stopped.
Her torn muscles were forced to move with mana and life force, her damaged bones no longer had the right to stop her body.
Her heart beat so heavily that every beat felt like a hit from inside her chest.
The closer she was to death, the more power she received, and she was very close at that moment.
[Remaining Duration: 00:40]
[All delayed damage will be applied after the effect ends.]
[Chance of death after the effect ends: Very High.]
She looked at the last line, there was no fear on her face.
"Then I have to finish this before that.

chapters.title: Chapter 388: The Remaining 10 Seconds
paragraphs: Seris moved, this time her speed could not be compared to before, not only because of her increased power but because her body was no longer following its own natural limits.
Her joints could break, her muscles could tear...it did not matter, Sovereign’s Last Stand would not allow anything to stop her.
Black Silence raised his hand and the Young Pendragon stared directly into his eyes.
[Sovereign’s Judgment.]
Mental pressure entered the Calamity’s existence without any physical path.
If the opponent had been at Seris’s level, they might have been completely stopped for several seconds.
But this enemy was a Calamity.
[Effect successful.]
[Spiritual Stun: 0.4 seconds.]
Four tenths of a second.
For a normal human it was almost nothing but for them and in a battle this important, it mattered a lot.
At that moment, Darian’s arrow was fired.

The seven-colored light hit Lian’s knee, the balance of his body changed for a fraction of a second and suddenly a huge explosion happened and a mushroom of fire covered an area of several hundred meters.
It was like a destructive bomb had fallen on him from above and the temperature around them suddenly rose to several thousand degrees.
And Seris came down from above and used the chance to its fullest.
[Heavenfall Execution.]
All the power in her body gathered into one strike and the sword hit Black Silence’s hand.
BOOOOOOM!
The ground under them exploded, the force pushed the dirt away for dozens of meters and the sound of a bone cracking was heard.
One of the bones in Lian’s hand cracked, his purple eyes narrowed slightly.
Seris gave a cold smile.
"Finally and now you understand pain" she said with calm anger and immediately moved back.
Black Silence did not answer, his other hand went directly toward Seris’s neck.
Darian released the bowstring again and the seven-colored arrow hit the Calamity’s wrist, the path of the punch changed by only a few centimeters.
That was enough and the punch passed beside the girl’s face.
The wind from it cut the skin of her cheek but she was alive and moved her sword at the same moment.
[Absolute Moonless Severance.]
Only the coordinates were selected, Lian’s chest and SHHK!
A deep cut suddenly appeared on his chest, blood sprayed from the wound and Black Silence actually took one step back.
Seris’s eyes opened wider, they were actually succeeding to some degree.
Inside Lian’s Ruined Heart, he saw that scene, a body that was actually injured, he did not expect this girl to have hidden such a trump card.
"This is it." he said in his mind with cold satisfaction.
Now Seris could kill his body.
But Black Silence only needed a few attacks to understand the pattern, the huge shadow behind his body suddenly gathered and the pressure around them became several times stronger.
The Young Pendragon noticed the change but it was already too late and something opened behind her.
A mouth.
Or something that her mind could only see as a mouth.
The space behind her sank inward and she wanted to move but a wave of darkness hit her back and her body was thrown forward.
Her ribs broke and part of her side opened, blood flowed out.
But Sovereign’s Last Stand did not allow her to fall, her feet dragged across the ground and she turned and swung her sword.
Black Silence grabbed her left arm and applied huge pressure.
A cracking sound echoed and another bone in the girl’s body broke.
Darian immediately moved away from a Cindari swordsman who was trying to hunt him after seeing that scene, and fired another arrow toward Black Silence.
The arrow hit Lian’s shoulder and his strength to hold became weak for a moment and that was enough for Seris to free herself.
Although her other arm was almost numb, she could barely feel the shoulder on that side of her body even now.
But the sword was still in her hand and that was enough, at least she could still continue, but for how long... that was another question.
"It’s not over yet." Seris said between heavy breaths and attacked again.
At the same time, the massacre behind them continued.
The Root Controller lifted Selina from the ground with three roots, the girl struggled in the air for several seconds and then the roots pulled her from three directions.
A body that was almost injured to the point of death fell down.
Aren immediately intervened when he saw that scene, he moved his hand and the ground moved, pushed the girl away and the Cindari angrily targeted him.
And now the native of the Ruined Realm itself retreated and used a strategy of escaping.
Rindo looked around for a moment, there were no support forces left, no Cindari, no selected Awakened and now even Selina was practically out of the battle.
The others could not even fight anymore and were mostly trying to escape from those damn things, although even in that they were not very lucky.
They were only lucky that Seraphina, Darian, Aren and himself were still able to continue and create a chance for the others to at least not be killed.
He was a little glad that they had brought Darian with them, although they had a bad feeling about him, he had been a great help for them.
In front of the four creatures that still barely looked tired.
[Time remaining until the Calamity is forced out: 03:14]

"Three minutes..." Rindo wiped the blood from his mouth. He whispered with a dark face, the situation was only getting worse and worse and it did not seem like it was moving toward getting better either.
Suddenly, one of the moving corpses attacked again and he had no more time to think.
[Time remaining: 02:48]
Seris created another cut on Lian’s arm and Black Silence answered with a punch.
She dodged, but the force of the punch hit her shoulder and finally the bone broke.
But the body continued moving despite the broken bone.
[Remaining duration of Sovereign’s Last Stand: 00:21]
Darian coughed up more blood and the seven rings behind his bow were becoming dimmer one by one.
He gritted his teeth, he was fighting one of the four Cindari and was also supporting Seris.
But his power also had a limit and he was getting close to it.
On the other side, inside the Ruined Heart, Lian was seeing everything, the result was already clear, the Young Pendragon had the ability to kill him and only needed one chance.
The panel in front of him was still there.
[Time for the Entity to intervene: 1.5 seconds.]
He moved his entire existence close to the edge of the Ruined Heart.
But he still did not move.
"Not yet." he said in his mind.
Black Silence still had part of his attention on the battlefield around him.
Seris was still not dangerous enough to force the Calamity to put all of his focus on her.
Lian waited, his instinct told him that the best chance was not far away.
[Time remaining until the Calamity is forced out: 02:01]
[Remaining duration of Sovereign’s Last Stand: 00:10]

chapters.title: Chapter 389: She Did It
paragraphs: Seris almost no longer looked like someone who should be able to stand, blood was running down from her side and arm.
Her left leg was badly injured and her left arm was useless.
Part of her face was covered in blood but her right hand was still barely holding the sword.

Half of the skin and flesh on her face was also completely gone because of the slap she had received from the Calamity, in short she was alive, but the moment the artifact turned off, she could be considered dead.
"Go!" Darian shouted with a rough and blood-covered voice and prepared his bow to fire again.
In this battle it had become clear that he had a terrifying ability as an archer, on average he was firing dozens of arrows every moment at two different creatures.
The Cindari that was chasing him and Black Silence and neither of them had managed to catch him yet, all of his shots were made while moving.
He did not stop even for one second and knew that if he stopped, it would be his death.
"Enough." Seris answered with cold confidence and then released everything she had left.
[Sovereign’s Judgment.]
This time something inside her became almost empty, the mental pressure hit Black Silence directly.
The Calamity immediately resisted but—
[Spiritual Stun: 0.7 seconds.]
Darian released all of his remaining arrows.
Seven lights were fired toward Black Silence from seven different directions and some of them were at angles that even Seris could not understand how they had been created.
Black Silence was forced to raise his defense, the huge shadow gathered and both hands moved.
Mana was compressed around his body and the Young Pendragon moved forward.
[Heavenfall Execution.]
The huge strike came down from above and the Calamity caught it, but this was not the main attack.
Seris’s eyes stayed fixed on Lian’s chest.
The heart.
[Absolute Moonless Severance.]
Black Silence understood at the same moment and his right hand left the defense and moved toward his heart, there was no concern on his face and he was sure that he could stop this attack.
But at that moment something happened that practically no one could have expected in any way.
[The Ruined Heart has activated.]
[Intervention in Host control has begun.]
Lian finally felt his own body but it happened so suddenly that he almost lost his focus at that moment.
A terrible headache and cold air entering his lungs.

The weight of blood in his veins, the beating of his heart, the contact of his feet with the ground, the sound of the battle and above all the existence of something impossible that was spread through every part of his body.
But he had no time to care about these things right now, his right hand was rising to defend his heart.
Lian broke the command and the hand went down.
Black Silence immediately resisted but the Young Vorhelm did the final part and all of the defense came down toward the heart.
Inside the dark ocean, Black Silence suddenly turned around.

And there he truly understood that the thing he had eaten, or at least the thing that should have been eaten, was still alive and anger and disbelief exploded through the entire existence of the Calamity.
But it was too late.
The purple light in Lian’s eyes disappeared and for less than a second his real eyes returned.
Seris saw them, her sword shook for a fraction of a second, she knew that look.
Cold, tired, a little bored but human! That look was human!
Lian, it was really Lian himself and he had been alive all this time.
Lian’s lips moved, time was almost over and he could only say two words.
"Do it." he said in his real voice, short and rough.
Seris’s healthy eye opened wider.
Lian did not wait, he moved his body forward by a few centimeters himself and directly went toward the sword, he never thought that he would go toward his own death like this.
The control was cut and the purple light exploded in his eyes again, Black Silence took back control of the body.
But it was too late.
Seris froze completely for a fraction of a second, all this time she had told herself that if there was no other way, she would kill Lian.
She had even told Seraphina, she had told Rindo, she had told herself many times.
If the choice was between one person and the world, the choice was clear.
But at that time she thought Lian no longer existed, she thought that the man was dead!
Now she had seen it herself, that same look and that same voice and his final words echoed in her mind again.
"Do it."
He was alive, and this truth made Seris’s hand actually shake.
[Sovereign’s Last Stand: 00:03]
Black Silence took over all of Lian’s face again and anger filled his existence.
His right hand rose and this time went directly toward Seris’s head, black threads covered his entire hand and he wanted to crush the girl’s skull.
And the Young Pendragon understood that there was no chance left, if she hesitated, it would be over and she would be the one who died.
Seris gritted her teeth so hard that pain spread through her jaw and her eye burned for a moment, the pressure of something she did not want to let out.
"Bastard..." she said with an angry but slightly shaking voice and held the sword hilt tighter.
She took one step forward.
"If you survive this..." she continued and her eyes stayed on the purple eyes for the last moment and her lips became a cold line.
"I’ll kill you again myself for this stupid plan."
And then she finally did it!
[Absolute Moonless Severance.]
The distance disappeared, there was no defense, Lian himself had lowered it and the cut directly formed at the coordinates of the heart.
Seris’s blade entered his chest, flesh was cut, bone moved aside and the tip of the sword came out from the back of his body, exactly through the heart and the purple eyes opened wider for a moment.
Black Silence’s hand was only a few centimeters away from Seris’s head and then stopped.
The heartbeat moved weakly once... again, and this time even weaker and then... nothing.
[Death of the Vessel detected.]
Seris held her breath, she succeeded! She finally succeeded!
[Anchor: Destroyed.]
[Vessel: Destroyed.]
[Conditions for killing the Calamity: 2/2]
[Congratulations.]
[Evolution mission completed successfully.]
[Evolution is available.]
But Seris did not even have time to feel happy, apart from the fact that all of her strength had completely left her muscles and she could no longer feel any part of her body,

And even her sword fell from her hand, her mana was completely drained, without even realizing it, with the complete loss of energy from her body and the loss of her ability to feel her body, she fell backward onto the ground.
All of those deep and severe wounds that had been forcibly closed opened again, and she was covered in her own blood.
The terrible pain of her bones being crushed and broken, which had been suppressed by the artifact, filled her entire body.
The pain was so terrible that she felt like her mind could break at any moment.
She was in the most defenseless state she had ever experienced in her life...at least she had managed to end everything, or at least that was what she thought...
However... everything was still not over
And in the deepest point of that dead body, inside the Ruined Heart, Lian had only one thought.
"Now it’s my turn."
His plan was still not complete.

The Cindari that was chasing him and Black Silence and neither of them had managed to catch him yet, all of his shots were made while moving.
He did not stop even for one second and knew that if he stopped, it would be his death.
"Enough." Seris answered with cold confidence and then released everything she had left.
[Sovereign’s Judgment.]
This time something inside her became almost empty, the mental pressure hit Black Silence directly.
The Calamity immediately resisted but—
[Spiritual Stun: 0.7 seconds.]
Darian released all of his remaining arrows.
Seven lights were fired toward Black Silence from seven different directions and some of them were at angles that even Seris could not understand how they had been created.
Black Silence was forced to raise his defense, the huge shadow gathered and both hands moved.
Mana was compressed around his body and the Young Pendragon moved forward.
[Heavenfall Execution.]
The huge strike came down from above and the Calamity caught it, but this was not the main attack.
Seris’s eyes stayed fixed on Lian’s chest.
The heart.
[Absolute Moonless Severance.]
Black Silence understood at the same moment and his right hand left the defense and moved toward his heart, there was no concern on his face and he was sure that he could stop this attack.
But at that moment something happened that practically no one could have expected in any way.
[The Ruined Heart has activated.]
[Intervention in Host control has begun.]
Lian finally felt his own body but it happened so suddenly that he almost lost his focus at that moment.
A terrible headache and cold air entering his lungs.

The weight of blood in his veins, the beating of his heart, the contact of his feet with the ground, the sound of the battle and above all the existence of something impossible that was spread through every part of his body.
But he had no time to care about these things right now, his right hand was rising to defend his heart.
Lian broke the command and the hand went down.
Black Silence immediately resisted but the Young Vorhelm did the final part and all of the defense came down toward the heart.
Inside the dark ocean, Black Silence suddenly turned around.

And there he truly understood that the thing he had eaten, or at least the thing that should have been eaten, was still alive and anger and disbelief exploded through the entire existence of the Calamity.
But it was too late.
The purple light in Lian’s eyes disappeared and for less than a second his real eyes returned.
Seris saw them, her sword shook for a fraction of a second, she knew that look.
Cold, tired, a little bored but human!
That look was human!
Lian, it was really Lian himself and he had been alive all this time.
Lian’s lips moved, time was almost over and he could only say two words.
"Do it." he said in his real voice, short and rough.
Seris’s healthy eye opened wider.
Lian did not wait, he moved his body forward by a few centimeters himself and directly went toward the sword, he never thought that he would go toward his own death like this.
The control was cut and the purple light exploded in his eyes again, Black Silence took back control of the body.
But it was too late.
Seris froze completely for a fraction of a second, all this time she had told herself that if there was no other way, she would kill Lian.
She had even told Seraphina, she had told Rindo, she had told herself many times.
If the choice was between one person and the world, the choice was clear.
But at that time she thought Lian no longer existed, she thought that the man was dead!
Now she had seen it herself, that same look and that same voice and his final words echoed in her mind again.
"Do it."
He was alive, and this truth made Seris’s hand actually shake.
[Sovereign’s Last Stand: 00:03]
Black Silence took over all of Lian’s face again and anger filled his existence.
His right hand rose and this time went directly toward Seris’s head, black threads covered his entire hand and he wanted to crush the girl’s skull.
And the Young Pendragon understood that there was no chance left, if she hesitated, it would be over and she would be the one who died.
Seris gritted her teeth so hard that pain spread through her jaw and her eye burned for a moment, the pressure of something she did not want to let out.
"Bastard..." she said with an angry but slightly shaking voice and held the sword hilt tighter.
She took one step forward.
"If you survive this..." she continued and her eyes stayed on the purple eyes for the last moment and her lips became a cold line.
"I’ll kill you again myself for this stupid plan."
And then she finally did it!
[Absolute Moonless Severance.]
The distance disappeared, there was no defense, Lian himself had lowered it and the cut directly formed at the coordinates of the heart.
Seris’s blade entered his chest, flesh was cut, bone moved aside and the tip of the sword came out from the back of his body, exactly through the heart and the purple eyes opened wider for a moment.
Black Silence’s hand was only a few centimeters away from Seris’s head and then stopped.
The heartbeat moved weakly once... again, and this time even weaker and then... nothing.
[Death of the Vessel detected.]
Seris held her breath, she succeeded!
She finally succeeded!
[Anchor: Destroyed.]
[Vessel: Destroyed.]
[Conditions for killing the Calamity: 2/2]
[Congratulations.]
[Evolution mission completed successfully.]
[Evolution is available.]
But Seris did not even have time to feel happy, apart from the fact that all of her strength had completely left her muscles and she could no longer feel any part of her body,

And even her sword fell from her hand, her mana was completely drained, without even realizing it, with the complete loss of energy from her body and the loss of her ability to feel her body, she fell backward onto the ground.
All of those deep and severe wounds that had been forcibly closed opened again, and she was covered in her own blood.
The terrible pain of her bones being crushed and broken, which had been suppressed by the artifact, filled her entire body.
The pain was so terrible that she felt like her mind could break at any moment.
She was in the most defenseless state she had ever experienced in her life...at least she had managed to end everything, or at least that was what she thought...
However... everything was still not over
And in the deepest point of that dead body, inside the Ruined Heart, Lian had only one thought.
"Now it’s my turn."
His plan was still not complete.

chapters.title: Chapter 390: The Calamity’s Confusion
paragraphs: "Now it’s my turn." Lian thought calmly in the darkness of the Ruined Heart.
While outside that hidden space, his body truly showed no sign of life.
His heart had stopped.
The blood was no longer moving through his veins, his brain activity had collapsed, and the mana paths that had been under Black Silence’s control only moments ago had gone out one after another.
His body lay on the ground; Seris’s sword was still passing through his chest, and its bloody tip was sticking out from his back.
The body was truly dead.
And exactly as Lian had predicted, Black Silence could not ignore this change.
Inside, the endless ocean of darkness that had surrounded the Ruined Heart for days began to retreat.
Countless mouths moved away one after another, and eyes that opened and closed in impossible places slowly moved toward somewhere beyond Lian’s spiritual existence.
The Calamity was leaving the body, though not exactly like a simple soul leaving a body, but its entire impossible structure was opening up.

Horns that had no clear direction, wings whose every part ended in another darkness, and mouths that could not fit inside any single body were coming out of the human shell that had compressed them inside for several days.
At that moment, a panel appeared in front of him.
[Death confirmed.]
[Extra Life has been automatically consumed.]
[Restoration process started.]
[Body Restoration: 0%]
[Estimated time until full recovery: 05:00]
"Five minutes?" Lian thought with slight sarcasm, if he had a face in that bodiless space, he probably would have raised an eyebrow slightly.
"Very generous." He continued dryly.
Five minutes.
On the surface, it was a lot of time.
But not when the Calamity was leaving his body and the world was also trying to push that creature out of its structure at the same time.
Lian could not let Black Silence escape.
All the pain he had endured, all the chains he had intentionally allowed to be broken, the awakening of the Titan, and even his own death had all been for gathering all of Black Silence in one place.
If it escaped now, this entire gamble would become meaningless.
He quickly went through the options he had left.
First, the Devouring Egg.
That creature was still under his control, and in terms of its nature, it was perhaps one of the few things that might have a chance of swallowing something at Black Silence’s level.
But the problem was obvious.
If the Devouring Egg ate the Calamity, it would not be "Lian" who swallowed it.

The system had specifically demanded in the Evolution Quest that he himself swallow one of the five Calamities, and there was no guarantee that using a creature as a middleman would complete the condition.
Even worse, he did not even know what would happen to the Devouring Egg if it really ate a Calamity.
A creature that was made to grow by swallowing things might no longer be something Lian would want to keep beside himself after eating something like Black Silence.
So this option was rejected.
Second option.
[Glutton]
This one was not even worth thinking about for long, [Glutton] swallowed skills and talents, and unfortunately not complete existences, especially not a Calamity that could infect an entire world.
So that one was also removed, leaving only one thing.
The Ruined Heart.
He turned his attention back to the huge structure in front of him.
For all the time he had been trapped here, he had focused on the cracks, the light inside them, and the boundary that had hidden him from Black Silence.
Five positions.
Five huge spaces were located around the central part of the Heart, each with a different shape and depth; as if something had once been placed on each one and then violently pulled out.
He stared at them for a few seconds, he had already made some guesses about them before, but he was not sure.
His mind immediately returned to the Evolution Quest.
[Condition: Swallow one of the five Calamities.]
Five Calamities and five positions, the chance that it was only a coincidence was almost ridiculous.
"So these are probably for you." He said thoughtfully as he felt the retreating presence of Black Silence.
His eyes moved back to the Heart itself, it was broken and had many cracks.
Some parts of it seemed to not exist at all, some cracks were far too deep, and the lines that should have completed its structure suddenly ended in nothing.
Maybe the Ruined Heart had not been like this from the beginning.
Maybe it had become incomplete, and if the five positions really were connected to the five Calamities, there was another possibility.
Was the Evolution Quest only designed to grow the monster class?
Or did every swallowed Calamity return something to the Heart?
Or maybe the Heart had been made from the beginning to hold those five creatures?
Lian had no answer, but he felt that perhaps the entire structure of his evolution was much deeper than he had thought.
Not only the structure of his evolution, but also the secret behind the existence of his Unknown Class that questioned all the limits of the other classes.
"I need to survive first, I’ll have time for philosophical questions later." He cut off his thoughts and looked away from the five positions.
Black Silence had almost left the body.
From inside the spiritual realm, Lian could feel the Calamity’s anger.
Anger from losing, anger from not knowing exactly what had happened.
Until a moment ago, everything had been over for it.
Lian had been destroyed, the Cindari was dead, the Titan had been released, and the remaining part of Black Silence had returned to its original existence.
It had found the best possible vessel and Earth, a world with billions of living creatures, was only a few minutes away.

Then the body itself had moved against its command, the defense had been lowered, and the voice of the body’s original owner, who should have been dead and should not have existed, had come out of its mouth.
And a sword had destroyed the heart of the body.

Black Silence still did not understand what had happened, and that was exactly why it was angry, because it did not understand how it had lost! Because it did not understand where it had made a mistake!
But it did not matter for now, the body was dead, the anchor had also been destroyed, and the world was pushing its presence away.
So it only had to leave, find another anchor and another vessel, and go to Earth, it could even use one of those four Cindari for now.
But just when the last part of the Calamity’s presence was about to leave the spiritual space, a sound like the cracking of the sky spread through the darkness.
Crack.
Lian turned around, the cracks on the Ruined Heart suddenly lit up, and golden light came out from between them.
Crack... crack...
The cracks became larger, for a moment he thought the Ruined Heart was breaking apart.
But no.
Two huge parts of the broken structure slowly moved away from each other, like doors that had been closed for thousands of years.
And behind them, light could be seen, pure golden light that lit up his entire soul.
He could get out and the path to the outside had opened.
Lian moved, his spiritual form passed through the light and entered the same spiritual realm where Black Silence was present.
And at that exact moment, the Calamity stopped, all the mouths, all the eyes, all the horns and shadows that had been moving toward the exit until that moment suddenly stopped.
Lian felt something like the gazes of hundreds of creatures on him at the same time.
Black Silence turned back, if such an impossible structure could even be called "turning back."
Countless eyes from different angles fixed on Lian.

And for the first time, he felt not only anger but also shock, the creature it had eaten, the identity it had erased step by step, the name it had removed from its mind... was standing in front of it!
"You..." Black Silence did not finish the sentence, and its voice spread through the spiritual realm from many directions at the same time.
Lian only looked at it, and the Calamity’s presence became tense for a moment.
"Impossible." Black Silence said with anger that this time it could not completely hide.
"How many impossible things have you seen today?" Lian answered calmly in an annoying way.
A wave of dark pressure formed around Black Silence.
But before attacking, its attention left Lian and moved behind him, toward the Ruined Heart that was still open, with golden light coming out from its cracks.

The Calamity remained completely still for a moment, something in its presence changed and it felt something strange, and in all the hundreds of eyes of this impossible structure, there was confusion.
"That... is that the thing?" It said more quietly, and all those eyes stayed on the Heart for a moment.
The Calamity understood now, on the first day it had taken over Lian’s body, it had checked the entire body, it had found many things, but it had felt something unknown.
Something that even it did not know, and it had only been able to feel its presence, but every time it searched for it, it found nothing.
It could not find any trace of that unknown thing, until it slowly came to the conclusion that maybe it had been mistaken...
But now that thing was in front of it.
"What is this?" Black Silence asked carefully.
"If you figure it out, I’d be happy if you told me too." Lian answered completely seriously, he himself had no idea what this thing was or how it was even inside his body.
"It doesn’t matter, I only need to destroy both of you." This time, the Calamity attacked immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 391: The Golden Aura
paragraphs: The darkness exploded.
Something like thousands of hands came out of the Calamity’s structure and at the same time reached toward Lian from all directions.
But unfortunately, he had no skills, no body and no mana either.
At that moment, if the Ruined Heart did not do something and help him, the battle would have ended before it even started.
This was a completely unfair battle, he had nothing to fight with, but there was no worry on his face, because he had already thought about this before.
The first dark hand was still several meters away from Lian’s spiritual form when the heart beat.
Thump.
The entire realm shook and a golden wave came out of the heart, the dark hands stopped for a moment when they touched it.
The golden light wrapped around Lian’s existence like thousands of broken threads.
An irregular golden aura, made of lines that sometimes broke and then formed again somewhere else.
And before he could even realize it, his consciousness took a shape, a shape exactly the same as his physical appearance.
[The Ruined Heart has reacted.]
[Emergency Authority has been granted.]
[The holder has received limited permission to use the power of the heart.]
[Time remaining: 02:30]
[Restrictions:]
[The granted power can only be used inside the spiritual realm.]
[The power cannot be stored, transferred or kept.]
[The holder cannot freely decide the form of the power.]
[The heart will decide the power that matches the threat.]
Lian stared at the notifications and then at the golden light surrounding him, it was a strange feeling, not the normal feeling of power that he felt after every increase in stats.
The feeling he had now was the feeling of being invincible, he felt like he could destroy anything, he felt like he was beyond everything.
He felt like he was the peak, the peak of what could exist, the peak of perfection and power and the peak of ascension.
This was exactly the same feeling he had when he saw the dark form of "Father" in the memories of the Black Silence.
That’s right... that was it, he had the feeling of being transcendent!
The heart only beat again and the Black Silence started its second attack while ignoring that thing.
This time Lian raised his hand, not because he knew what to do but because a sudden instinct simply told him to move.
The golden light gathered around his arm.
[Ruined Severance]
He brought his hand down and a golden line appeared in the spiritual realm.
It passed directly through one of the huge extensions of the Calamity and for a moment, it was as if nothing had happened... but that part was cut off!
Completely cut off!
Several mouths along with part of one of the impossible horns of the Black Silence separated from the main structure and fell into the darkness.
A sound spread through the spiritual realm, it was nothing like a human scream but something deeper, something that shook the entire spiritual space.
The Black Silence moved back, because it felt pain!
Not physical pain from the body it had occupied, not damage received by the vessel but itself... the Calamity itself was truly in pain.
Lian kept his eyes on the severed part, waiting for it to return or grow again or something similar to that, but surprisingly, it did not return.
The severed mouths stayed silent, their eyes closed and the darkness around them fell apart.
The Black Silence understood the same thing.
"No..." it said in disbelief and its presence pulled back for a moment before its anger returned.
"Familiar powers cannot hurt me." it said in a heavy voice, as if it was not arguing with Lian but with reality itself.
It was an existence beyond all dimensions and forms of life!
An existence that was not bound to death or life!
An existence created to devour, kill and destroy worlds!
It could not die! It was immortal! Its true form was indestructible!
Then why? Why had an inferior existence been able to hurt it? Why was its form not regenerating?
What were those damned golden lights?
"So I guess these golden lights are not mortal." Lian looked at the golden aura around his hand and then answered coldly.
He had guessed that this might be the case, after all, just being wrapped in this aura itself made him feel transcendent.
The Calamity’s anger exploded and thousands of mouths opened at once, but this time it was not a direct attack, instead, voices poured out.
Young Vorhelm was suddenly no longer in the spiritual realm, or at least that was what his mind thought, instead he saw a world where the sky was green.
A child shaking his mother’s body on a street covered in ash and then the image broke.
Another world, a black sea and floating islands, four-armed creatures killing each other inside temples.
The next image, a king, a soldier, a mother, a monster and millions of memories.
Lives that the Black Silence had touched or devoured in different worlds entered Lian’s mind at the same time.
Sadness, fear, murder, hunger, madness, thousands of languages and thousands of names.
For a moment Lian even forgot which memories belonged to himself.
"I..." Ed started the sentence, but his own name disappeared for a fraction of a second among millions of other names.
The Black Silence had understood that a direct attack was dangerous, it did not want to make another direct attack until it understood what those golden lights were.
So it chose a better approach, mental and spiritual attacks that could break apart a mortal mind, no matter how powerful it was.
Unfortunately, it had underestimated those golden lights too much.
At that moment, the Ruined Heart beat.
Thump.
The golden light became stronger and the memories around Lian started to crack... like huge sheets of glass, they started to break.
One crack.
A hundred cracks.
Then everything shattered and he was standing in the spiritual realm again.
"You already tried this one before, don’t tell me this is all you can do?" he said coldly and took a step forward.
The Black Silence did not move back, but anger burned inside all those eyes, this was the second time it had felt such humiliation because of a mortal.
The first time was hundreds of years ago, when the natives of this small world sealed it inside that Titan.
It would not allow an inferior mortal to humiliate it.
The space around it opened and then was eaten.
The spiritual realm itself started to be eaten and part of the spiritual space on its right literally disappeared.
It no longer existed.
The Calamity was devouring space itself and everything was turning into nothingness, and that disappearance started spreading toward Lian.
And Young Vorhelm attacked once again.
[Ruined Boundary]
The golden aura around him suddenly expanded and a huge ring appeared, and wherever the golden light passed, the eaten part of the space formed again.
But there was a problem, broken pillars, cracked ground, a broken sky and collapsed walls that had never existed before appeared inside that spiritual realm where nothing should have existed.
The Ruined Heart was not returning what had been destroyed to its original state, instead, it was turning it into the ruins of something that had once existed.
"This... is strange." Lian muttered, why was it turning this spiritual realm into the appearance of an old ruin instead of simply rebuilding it normally?
Was there a reason? Or did it want to show him something? Or could this be a special place?

The spiritual realm was his soul, in fact, they were now inside the deepest point of his soul, although only a small part of his soul remained and the rest had already been destroyed by the Black Silence.
Of course, it was now being rebuilt with the help of the extra life.
Anyway, the main advantage of this skill that had been used was something else.
The moment Ruined Boundary reached the Black Silence, the Calamity’s structure shook.
Something was forced onto it, a form... it was forced to take one single form.
The mouths moved, the horns became fixed and the eyes that had been placed in impossible distances were forced onto one single structure.
For several seconds, the Black Silence was no longer a formless and limitless existence.
Instead, it had been forced to be "something" and something that had a form could be cut and devoured.
Lian moved.
[Ruined Severance]
A second golden line appeared and another part of the Calamity’s existence was cut off.
It did not return again.
This time the Black Silence reacted differently, the anger was still there but beneath it, calculation appeared.
An existence that believed itself to be indestructible was now facing the possibility of its own destruction.
Not a temporary defeat like being sealed inside the Titan, but true destruction, something it had never thought was possible.
It was not made to fight or battle, it was created to spread corruption and calamity, to drive life forms into madness and worlds into killing and chaos.
Its form was more of a concept than something that had power by itself, it only had power when it had a vessel that could show that power.
And because of this, as long as it continued destroying worlds, it could maintain its immortality, but when it stopped doing this and its hunger was no longer bearable, it would fall apart.
But now something else had appeared that could cancel its immortality.
And that alone was enough to change the entire situation and caused something inside it to change.
To change its purpose
( Black Silence’s visualization )

sentences.text: The darkness exploded.
Something like thousands of hands came out of the Calamity’s structure and at the same time reached toward Lian from all directions.
But unfortunately, he had no skills, no body and no mana either.
At that moment, if the Ruined Heart did not do something and help him, the battle would have ended before it even started.
This was a completely unfair battle, he had nothing to fight with, but there was no worry on his face, because he had already thought about this before.
The first dark hand was still several meters away from Lian’s spiritual form when the heart beat.
Thump.
The entire realm shook and a golden wave came out of the heart, the dark hands stopped for a moment when they touched it.
The golden light wrapped around Lian’s existence like thousands of broken threads.
An irregular golden aura, made of lines that sometimes broke and then formed again somewhere else.
And before he could even realize it, his consciousness took a shape, a shape exactly the same as his physical appearance.
[The Ruined Heart has reacted.]
[Emergency Authority has been granted.]
[The holder has received limited permission to use the power of the heart.]
[Time remaining: 02:30]
[Restrictions:]
[The granted power can only be used inside the spiritual realm.]
[The power cannot be stored, transferred or kept.]
[The holder cannot freely decide the form of the power.]
[The heart will decide the power that matches the threat.]
Lian stared at the notifications and then at the golden light surrounding him, it was a strange feeling, not the normal feeling of power that he felt after every increase in stats.
The feeling he had now was the feeling of being invincible, he felt like he could destroy anything, he felt like he was beyond everything.
He felt like he was the peak, the peak of what could exist, the peak of perfection and power and the peak of ascension.
This was exactly the same feeling he had when he saw the dark form of "Father" in the memories of the Black Silence.
That’s right... that was it, he had the feeling of being transcendent!
The heart only beat again and the Black Silence started its second attack while ignoring that thing.
This time Lian raised his hand, not because he knew what to do but because a sudden instinct simply told him to move.
The golden light gathered around his arm.
[Ruined Severance]
He brought his hand down and a golden line appeared in the spiritual realm.
It passed directly through one of the huge extensions of the Calamity and for a moment, it was as if nothing had happened... but that part was cut off!
Completely cut off!
Several mouths along with part of one of the impossible horns of the Black Silence separated from the main structure and fell into the darkness.
A sound spread through the spiritual realm, it was nothing like a human scream but something deeper, something that shook the entire spiritual space.
The Black Silence moved back, because it felt pain!
Not physical pain from the body it had occupied, not damage received by the vessel but itself... the Calamity itself was truly in pain.
Lian kept his eyes on the severed part, waiting for it to return or grow again or something similar to that, but surprisingly, it did not return.
The severed mouths stayed silent, their eyes closed and the darkness around them fell apart.
The Black Silence understood the same thing.
"No..." it said in disbelief and its presence pulled back for a moment before its anger returned.
"Familiar powers cannot hurt me." it said in a heavy voice, as if it was not arguing with Lian but with reality itself.
It was an existence beyond all dimensions and forms of life!
An existence that was not bound to death or life!
An existence created to devour, kill and destroy worlds!
It could not die!
It was immortal!
Its true form was indestructible!
Then why?
Why had an inferior existence been able to hurt it?
Why was its form not regenerating?
What were those damned golden lights?
"So I guess these golden lights are not mortal." Lian looked at the golden aura around his hand and then answered coldly.
He had guessed that this might be the case, after all, just being wrapped in this aura itself made him feel transcendent.
The Calamity’s anger exploded and thousands of mouths opened at once, but this time it was not a direct attack, instead, voices poured out.
Young Vorhelm was suddenly no longer in the spiritual realm, or at least that was what his mind thought, instead he saw a world where the sky was green.
A child shaking his mother’s body on a street covered in ash and then the image broke.
Another world, a black sea and floating islands, four-armed creatures killing each other inside temples.
The next image, a king, a soldier, a mother, a monster and millions of memories.
Lives that the Black Silence had touched or devoured in different worlds entered Lian’s mind at the same time.
Sadness, fear, murder, hunger, madness, thousands of languages and thousands of names.
For a moment Lian even forgot which memories belonged to himself.
"I..." Ed started the sentence, but his own name disappeared for a fraction of a second among millions of other names.
The Black Silence had understood that a direct attack was dangerous, it did not want to make another direct attack until it understood what those golden lights were.
So it chose a better approach, mental and spiritual attacks that could break apart a mortal mind, no matter how powerful it was.
Unfortunately, it had underestimated those golden lights too much.
At that moment, the Ruined Heart beat.
Thump.
The golden light became stronger and the memories around Lian started to crack... like huge sheets of glass, they started to break.
One crack.
A hundred cracks.
Then everything shattered and he was standing in the spiritual realm again.
"You already tried this one before, don’t tell me this is all you can do?" he said coldly and took a step forward.
The Black Silence did not move back, but anger burned inside all those eyes, this was the second time it had felt such humiliation because of a mortal.
The first time was hundreds of years ago, when the natives of this small world sealed it inside that Titan.
It would not allow an inferior mortal to humiliate it.
The space around it opened and then was eaten.
The spiritual realm itself started to be eaten and part of the spiritual space on its right literally disappeared.
It no longer existed.
The Calamity was devouring space itself and everything was turning into nothingness, and that disappearance started spreading toward Lian.
And Young Vorhelm attacked once again.
[Ruined Boundary]
The golden aura around him suddenly expanded and a huge ring appeared, and wherever the golden light passed, the eaten part of the space formed again.
But there was a problem, broken pillars, cracked ground, a broken sky and collapsed walls that had never existed before appeared inside that spiritual realm where nothing should have existed.
The Ruined Heart was not returning what had been destroyed to its original state, instead, it was turning it into the ruins of something that had once existed.
"This... is strange." Lian muttered, why was it turning this spiritual realm into the appearance of an old ruin instead of simply rebuilding it normally?
Was there a reason?
Or did it want to show him something?
Or could this be a special place?

The spiritual realm was his soul, in fact, they were now inside the deepest point of his soul, although only a small part of his soul remained and the rest had already been destroyed by the Black Silence.
Of course, it was now being rebuilt with the help of the extra life.
Anyway, the main advantage of this skill that had been used was something else.
The moment Ruined Boundary reached the Black Silence, the Calamity’s structure shook.
Something was forced onto it, a form... it was forced to take one single form.
The mouths moved, the horns became fixed and the eyes that had been placed in impossible distances were forced onto one single structure.
For several seconds, the Black Silence was no longer a formless and limitless existence.
Instead, it had been forced to be "something" and something that had a form could be cut and devoured.
Lian moved.
[Ruined Severance]
A second golden line appeared and another part of the Calamity’s existence was cut off.
It did not return again.
This time the Black Silence reacted differently, the anger was still there but beneath it, calculation appeared.
An existence that believed itself to be indestructible was now facing the possibility of its own destruction.
Not a temporary defeat like being sealed inside the Titan, but true destruction, something it had never thought was possible.
It was not made to fight or battle, it was created to spread corruption and calamity, to drive life forms into madness and worlds into killing and chaos.
Its form was more of a concept than something that had power by itself, it only had power when it had a vessel that could show that power.
And because of this, as long as it continued destroying worlds, it could maintain its immortality, but when it stopped doing this and its hunger was no longer bearable, it would fall apart.
But now something else had appeared that could cancel its immortality.
And that alone was enough to change the entire situation and caused something inside it to change.
To change its purpose
( Black Silence’s visualization )

chapters.title: Chapter 392: Devouring A Calamity
paragraphs: Lian felt it, this was not fear; not in the way Humans knew it, but it was the closest thing to it.
The recognition of a real threat.
[Body Reconstruction: 37%]
[Estimated Time Remaining: 03:09]
[Emergency Authority of the Ruined Heart: 01:56]
Time was running out faster than he wanted, and the Black Silence seemed to have reached the same conclusion.
It no longer moved forward to kill Lian, instead it moved back and its entire huge structure was being pulled toward the exit, wanting to completely leave this body.
"I’m not letting you do that." Lian said coldly and opened both his hands toward it.
[Ruined Chain]
The sound of metal being dragged spread through the entire realm.
Grrrrrrrrr!
Suddenly, the golden lights surrounding him became solid and metallic, and through his hands, they shot toward the Calamity like a spider web.
A chain wrapped around one of the main parts of the Black Silence.
A second one came out.
Then a third.
The Calamity suddenly stopped, the chains became tight and it tried to free itself by forcefully pulling them, but just touching that golden light was enough to make its body start burning.
But the Black Silence struggled and, while enduring the pain, tried to break the chains, and one of the chains made a cracking sound at that moment.
"They’re not that strong." Lian said with a slight frown, but he grabbed the chains with both hands.
Pressure was applied.
But this was not just a simple struggle between holding the chains, each side had a very important goal and they were using all their strength.
The Black Silence knew that it was facing something unknown, and if it did not escape right now, it would truly be destroyed and truly disappear.
And Lian could not let it leave, because aside from the fact that this great threat would remain alive and might return in the future, his Evolution Quest would not be completed either.
That was why neither side was willing to stop using force.
But the Black Silence suddenly stopped all its efforts to escape.
The eyes turned toward the Heart and toward Lian, and for a moment, instinctive fear was replaced by something else.
Necessity.
That power had to be understood, not by itself but by the "Father".
The existence of something that could injure the Father’s children could not remain unknown.

This power was not mortal, it was not a normal law of the world, and even the Black Silence could not understand its nature, and if something like this could injure it, then perhaps it could also injure its brothers and sisters.
Perhaps even more... Father had to know about this thing.
The Calamity’s goal changed at that moment, Earth was no longer the priority, the feast of billions of lives could wait.
It had to escape, it had to deliver this information.
The Black Silence put all its power into the chains.
One cracked.
Crack!
Lian pulled his spiritual body forward.
"No, no, no... I already told you, I’m not letting you escape!" He said with a deep frown and increased the pressure.
The second chain shook.
The Black Silence suddenly attacked Lian’s mind directly, this time it was not a foreign memory.
Instead, it tried to use the same ability it had used before, it tried to erase Lian’s own identity once again.
His name disappeared from his awareness for a moment.
His face.
His memories.
His sense of self.
The same process that had almost destroyed him before started again.
The voice of the Calamity came from everywhere.
"You disappeared once before. And now I will eat you again!" It said in a deep voice as darkness began to crawl over Lian’s spiritual body.
Part of Lian’s form disappeared from below his shoulder.
The pain was real this time, Young Vorhelm felt like a part of his existence had been torn apart, this pain was beyond the physical level, this was a pain that made the soul itself shake.
But the Ruined Heart did not immediately repair him and the pieces of his existence spread through the air like glass, and his spiritual body began to disappear.
Then golden light passed between them and the pieces returned one by one.
Every piece felt like a hot nail being driven into his soul when it connected again.
He let out a short sound of pain but did not release the chain.
"The first time... you caught me off guard." He said through the pressure and took another spiritual step backward.
The chain became tight and the Black Silence was pulled several more meters toward the Heart, and the golden light around it became stronger.
"This time, it’s my turn." Lian pulled the chains with all his will.
The Calamity roared and the Spiritual Realm shook.

[Emergency Authority of the Ruined Heart: 00:57]
Lian saw the last number, he had less than a minute left and the Black Silence was still outside the Ruined Heart.
It was far too large for three chains to hold easily, and he needed to weaken it, but at that moment the Calamity attacked him itself.
One of the fixed appendages inside the Ruined Boundary struck Lian’s existence directly.
Half of his spiritual body from the waist up was destroyed and for a moment only darkness remained.
Unimaginable pain pushed against his awareness, if he had a body, he might have lost consciousness at that moment.
But there was nothing here that could become unconscious, and the pieces of his existence appeared in the air again.
The Ruined Heart gathered them.
They all came together again like pieces of broken glass.
"This... really hurt." Lian had no breath, but he felt like he needed to breathe and said with calm anger.
The Black Silence attacked again, but this time he raised his hand.
[Ruined Severance]
The golden cut passed through the central part of the Calamity, this time the damage was not small and a huge part of the darkness was cut away.
Hundreds of mouths closed at once and countless eyes went dark.
The Calamity was pulled backward and clear fear spread through its presence.
Something had been taken from it, a complete part of it was gone, forever and there was no way to deny it anymore.

That creature was not indestructible, at least not against this thing, this thing whose nature was completely unknown and even it, which should have been able to understand everything, could not identify it.
"This should not exist." The Black Silence stared at the Heart and said quietly.
"Something in the mortal worlds should not be able to hurt us." It continued and its remaining mouths opened one after another.
"Us?" Lian raised an eyebrow in his mind, so he was not the only one.
Of course, he knew this from its memories, the Father, the five Calamities that seemed to be his children, he already knew about them, but hearing direct confirmation was still valuable.
The Black Silence looked toward the exit and said a name that made Young Vorhelm become completely serious.
"Father must know." It said in a way that was more like an instinctive necessity, it could not let a threat that could destroy them remain unknown.
Lian’s eyes narrowed slightly, "Father", the same existence, something that even the Black Silence seemed small in front of.
"He’s not going to understand anything, and you’re not leaving this place either." He then said simply and pulled the chain harder.
"You don’t understand what you have, that thing should not exist!" The Calamity turned back and answered with anger mixed with anxiety.
"I agree with you on that, but I don’t think you’ll have time to explain it to me." He replied dryly.
He was not stupid enough to think that bringing something like this upon the true structure of an existence created to destroy worlds was simple.
It was true that no matter how powerful the Calamity was, it needed a vessel that could carry it and with its help spread chaos, destruction and ruin.
But even so, this was still not something that just anyone, no matter how powerful, could deal with easily.
This strange power showed what kind of abilities the Ruined Heart had, and it made him even more curious about what exactly he was facing.
[Emergency Authority of the Ruined Heart: 00:24]
A chain broke.
Crack!
The golden light inside the links went out and the Black Silence was immediately pulled several meters toward the exit.
Lian held the two remaining chains with all his strength and put all his power into them.
Suddenly, more golden lights shot from his hands toward the Black Silence and more chains surrounded it.
Before it could do anything, it was forcefully pulled toward the opening of the Heart.
The Heart beat.
Boom.
The five empty slots lit up at the same time for the first time.
Lian turned to look, the light in four of the slots immediately disappeared, but one remained lit, purple, and a dark purple aura rose from the hollow.
The shape of the slot began to change, as if something inside it had finally recognized the presence of the Black Silence.
A panel appeared.
[Evolution Target Confirmed.]
[First Calamity Identified.]
[Name: Black Silence.]
[Corresponding Slot Identified.]

The Black Silence stopped at that moment and its entire existence turned back toward the Heart, it understood, not what this slot was, but its instinct understood that it was not going to be imprisoned.
Something else was going to happen, something it really did not like and a bad feeling filled it.
[Swallowing Process Started.]
The entire Ruined Heart opened, not just the same crack as before, but its structure spread open like a huge mouth made of golden light and cracked blackness.
A pulling force appeared and the Calamity screamed for the first time, truly screamed, a scream of fear!
"No! Father, save me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 393: First Evolution Available
paragraphs: The chains pulled tight and the Black Silence moved toward the Heart.
Slowly but without stopping.
"This can’t..." It began with disbelief and grabbed at everything around it with its entire structure.
There was nothing to grab, the Ruined Heart was pulling itself and it could not stop it.
Lian did not release the chains and continued pulling it with all his strength.
[Emergency Authority: 00:09]
The Black Silence struggled wildly, parts of its body stretched, some mouths screamed, some eyes stared directly at Lian and cursed him.
Another chain suddenly cracked.
But half of the Calamity had entered the Heart.
"Father must know!" The Calamity screamed this time with anger mixed with something similar to fear.
"Then I’ll tell him myself when I see him." Lian replied with cold sarcasm and pulled the last chain.
The Black Silence tried to take his identity again, it tried to use all its power for a spiritual attack.
But those damned chains, that damned unknown golden light, were completely draining it and destroying its powers.
But Young Vorhelm was not doing nothing either, even if it was because of anger, he continued pulling it with all his strength.
This body belonged to him.
This soul belonged to him.
This Heart, whatever it was, was at least inside him.
And he was punishing this bastard who had dared to occupy his body and almost destroy his entire soul.
The Black Silence had almost completely entered and only part of its huge shadow remained outside.
"Let me go! You don’t know what you’re doing—"
"If Father finds out, he will destroy you! He will destroy your world! He will destroy everyone you care about!"
But it was already too late, the entire Calamity went inside and the two halves of the Heart closed with tremendous force.
BOOOOOOM!
And then complete silence filled everything.
Lian did not move for several seconds and only looked at the Heart, and the Ruined Heart was closed.
The golden light around him also slowly disappeared.
[Emergency Authority Ended.]
He remained there and waited to see what would happen, what the result would be and whether his guess and gamble had been correct or not.
One second.
Two seconds.
Three.
Nothing happened and only the revival panel in the corner of his vision moved.
[Body Reconstruction: 86%]
[Estimated Time Remaining: 00:42]
But he did not pay attention to it, all his attention was on the Heart, what if the Calamity had only been imprisoned?
What if the Heart had failed to swallow it? What if it came out again after a few minutes?
But suddenly, the notifications he had been waiting for appeared.
[Processing Swallowed Entity...]
[Matching Entity with Evolution Structure...]
[Stabilizing...]
[Congratulations.]
[You have swallowed a Calamity.]
[Swallowed Calamity: Black Silence.]
[First Evolution Quest Condition Completed.]
[Evolution Available.]
For a moment, he only looked at the message.
It was over.
It had not been sealed and it had not escaped, and the system had directly confirmed that he had swallowed the Black Silence.
"Finally." He said with a relief that even he could not completely hide.
All those difficulties, all that pain and sacrifice had finally paid off, the Calamity that could threaten their world and the lives of billions of people had finally been eliminated.
All his efforts had finally paid off and now his first Evolution was available.
The Ruined Heart began to open again.
Lian immediately prepared himself and suddenly raised his guard for any abnormality, but this time no dark pressure came out from inside.
Only light came from inside it and the crack opened enough for him to see inside.
The five slots were still there, four slots were empty but the fifth slot was no longer empty.
Something was placed on it, it was statue-like or perhaps something that the Heart had decided to show in the form of a statue.
A small faceless figure was sitting in the center of the slot.
A robe made of darkness was wrapped around it, but the darkness was not moving, several closed mouths could be seen on the surface of the figure.
A broken ring floated behind it.
